a: Hayeynu "medammea".
Veiddach – kenasa hu, umikkenasa la yalfinan.
Uleman deyalef kenasa mikkenasa – kol hane lema li?
Tzericha; dei tena metamme; i teruma – hava amena mishshum deka mafsed la ligmare, vei metamme chullin – mishshum deasur ligrom tumea lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael; aval medammea – ema la.
Vei ashmeinan medammea – mishshum dishchiach, aval metamme, dela shechiach – ema la.
Vei ashmeinan metamme umedammea – mishshum dela kim leh bidrabba minneh,
Aval menassech, dekim leh bidrabba minneh – ema la; ka mashma lan – kidrabbi yirmeya.
Uleha detane avu derabbi avin: barishona hayu omrim hametamme vehamenassech, chazru lomar af hamedammea, kol hane lema li?
Tzericha; dei ashmeinan metamme – mishshum dela kim leh bidrabba minneh; aval menassech, dekim leh bidrabba minneh – ema la;
Vei ashmeinan menassech – mishshum deka mafsed leh ligmare; aval metamme, dela mafsed leh ligmare – ema la;
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte – mishshum dehefsed merubbe; aval medammea, dehefsed muat – ema la; tzericha.
Amar chizkiyya: devar tora – echad shogeg, veechad mezid – chayyayv. may tama? hezzek sheeno nikkar shemeh hezzek.
Uma taam amru beshogeg patur – kede sheyyodio.
I hachi, afillu bemezid name! hasheta leozoke ka mechavven, odoe la moda leh?!

Verabbi yochanan amar: devar tora – echad shogeg, veechad mezid – patur. may tama? hezzek sheeno nikkar – la shemeh hezzek. uma taam amru bemezid chayyayv – shello yehe kol echad veechad holech umetamme tohorotav shel chavero, veomer "patur ani".
Tenan: hakkohanim sheppiggelu bammikdash, mezidim – chayyayvin; vetane ala: mippene tikkun haolam.
Vei amrat hezzek sheeno nikkar shemeh hezzek, hay "shoggin peturin mippene tikkun haolam" mibbee leh!
Hachi name kaamar: mezidin – chayyayvin; ha shoggin – peturin mippene tikkun haolam.
Metiv rabbi elazar: haose melacha beme chattat uvefarat chattat, patur middine adam vechayyayv bedine shamayim. vei amrat hezzek sheeno nikkar shemeh hezzek, bedine adam name lechayyev!
Hu motev la – vehu mefarek la: para – shehichnisah lerivka al menat shettinak vetadush; me chattat – sheshshakal bahen mishkalot.
Vehaamar rava: me chattat
b: Sheshshakal bahen mishkalot, keshera! la kashya: ha begufan, ha bichnegdan.
Begufan – maase ka aved behu; vei hezzek sheeno nikkar shemeh hezzek, bedine adam name lechayyev! ella idde veidde bichnegdan; vela kashya – ha deassach dateh. ha dela assach dateh.
Metiv rav pappa: gazal matbea, venifsal; teruma, venitmet; chametz, veavar alav happesach; omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha".
Vei amrat hezzek sheeno nikkar shemeh hezzek, hay gazlan hu, mamona mealleya bae shallome! teyuveta.
Lema ketannae: hametamme vehamedammea vehamenassech, echad shogeg veechad mezid – chayyayv, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: beshogeg – patur, bemezid – chayyayv.
May, lav beha kamippalgi – demar savar: hezzek sheeno nikkar shemeh hezzek; umar savar: la shemeh hezzek?

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: dechulle alma hezzek sheeno nikkar la shemeh hezzek; vehacha bekansu shogeg attu mezid ka mippalgi – demar savar: kansu shogeg attu mezid; umar savar: lo kansu shogeg attu mezid.

Verame derabbi meir adderabbi meir, verame derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda – detanya: hamevashshel beshabbat; beshogeg – yeachel, bemezid – lo yeachel, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: beshogeg – yeachel lemotzae shabbat, bemezid – lo yeachel olamit.

Rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer: beshogeg, yeachel lemotzae shabbat – laacherim, velo lo; bemezid, lo yeachel olamit – lo lo, velo laacherim. kashya derabbi meir adderabbi meir, kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda!
Derabbi meir adderabbi meir la kashya – ki kanes, bidrabbanan; bidorayyta la kanes.
Veha menassech deorayyta hu, veka kanes! mishshum chumera daavoda zara, kanes leh.
Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya – ki la kanes, bidrabbanan; bidorayyta – kanes. veha menassech deorayyta, vela kanes! mishshum chumera daavoda zara. mivdal bedili minneh.
Verame derabbi meir adderabbi meir bidorayyta – detanya: hannotea bashshabbat, beshogeg – yekayyem; bemezid – yaakor; uvashsheviit – ben beshogeg ben bemezid yaakor, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: bashsheviit – beshogeg yekayyem, bemezid yaakor; uvashshabbat – ben beshogeg ben bemezid, yaakor.
Uletamaych, tikkashe lach hi gufa – mikkede ha deorayyta veha deorayyta, may shena shabbat umay shena sheviit?

Ella hatam, kidkatane tama – amar rabbi meir: mippene ma ani omer bashshabbat – beshogeg yekayyem, bemezid yaakor; uvashsheviit – ben beshogeg ben bemezid yaakor? mippene sheyyisrael monin lashsheviit,

a: Veen monin leshabbatot.
Davar acher: nechshedu yisrael al hashsheviit, velo nechshedu al hashshabbatot.
May "davar acher"? hachi kaamar: vechi tema shabbat name, zimnin demikkela yom sheloshim – beshabbat, dei nata hahu yoma hu desalka leh shatta, vei la – la salka leh shatta,
Ta shema davar acher: nechshedu yisrael al hashsheviit, velo nechshedu al hashshabbatot.
Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya – beatreh derabbi yehuda chamira lehu sheviit.
Dehahu daamar leh lachavero: dayyayr bar dayyayrta! amar leh: ana la achli pere dishviit kevotach.

Ta shema: achal teruma temea – meshallem chullin tehorin. shillem chullin temeim, mahu? amar somchos mishshum rabbi meir: beshogeg – tashlumav tashlumin, bemezid – en tashlumav tashlumin. vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze tashlumav tashlumin, vechozer umeshallem chullin tehorim.
Vehavenan ba: bemezid – ammay en tashlumav tashlumin? tavo alav beracha – deachel minneh midde dela chaze leh bime tumeato, veka meshallem leh midde dachaze leh bime tumeato!

Veamar rava, veamri la kedi: chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: achal teruma temea – meshallem kol dehu. achal teruma tehora – meshallem chullin tehorim. shillem chullin temein, mahu? somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir: beshogeg – tashlumav tashlumin, bemezid – en tashlumav tashlumin. vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze – tashlumav tashlumin, vechozer umeshallem chullin tehorin.
Veamar rav acha bereh derav ika: hacha bekansu shogeg attu mezid ikka benayyhu (derabbi meir savar: lo kansu shogeg attu mezid, vachachamim omrim: kansu)!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam – gavra leshallome ka mikkavven, anan nekum velikneseh?!
Ta shema: dam shennitma, uzerako; beshogeg – huretza, bemezid – lo huretza.
Amar lach rabbi meir: hachi hasheta?! hatam – gavra lechappore ka mechavven, anan nekum venikneseh?!
Ta shema: hameasser bashshabbat; beshogeg – yochal, bemezid – lo yochal. hachi hasheta?! hatam – gavra letakkone ka mikkavven, anan lekum velikneseh?!
Ta shema: hammatbil kelim bashshabbat; beshogeg – yishtammesh bahen, bemezid – lo yishtammesh bahen! hachi hasheta?! hatam – gavra letahore mane ka mikkavven, anan lekum velikneseh?!
Verame derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda – bidrabbanan, detanya:
b: Naflu venitpatztzeu; echad shogeg, veechad mezid – lo yaalu, divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: beshogeg – yaalu, bemezid – lo yaalu.
Veha hacha, demiddeorayyta chad bitre batel, verabbanan hu digzur, veka kanes rabbi yehuda! hatam hayeynu tama derabbi yehuda, mishshum deate leiarome.

Verame derabbi yose adderabbi yose – ditnan: netia shel orla veshel kile hakkerem shennitarvu bintiot acherot, hare ze lo yelakket. veim likket – yaalu beechad umatayim, uvilvad shello yitkavven lelakket.
Rabbi yose omer: af hammitkavven lelakket – yaalu beechad umatayim!
Ha ittemar ala, amar rava: chazaka en adam oser et karmo bintia achat. vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: chazaka en adam oser et karmo bintia achat.
Mishna hakkohanim sheppiggelu bammikdash, mezidin – chayyayvin.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: haya ose immo bitharot, veamar lo: teharot sheasiti immecha, nitmeu; haya ose immo bizvachim, veamar lo: zevachim sheasiti immecha, nitpaggelu – neeman. aval amar lo: teharot sheasiti immecha beyom peloni nitmeu, uzevachim sheasiti immecha beyom peloni nitpaggelu – eno neeman.
May shena resha, umay shena sefa? amar abbaye: kol shebbeyado – neeman.
Rava amar: kegon deashkecheh vela amar leh vela midde, ulevatar hachi ashkecheh vaamar leh.

Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: teharot sheasiti immecha beyom peloni – nitmeu, ata lekammeh derabbi amme, amar leh: shurat haddin eno neeman. amar lefanav rabbi assi: rabbi, atta omer ken? hachi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose: ma eese shehattora heeminattu.

Hechan heeminattu? amar rabbi yitzchak bar bisna: kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim yochiach, dechi amar piggul – meheman; umena yadinan? vehachtiv: "vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed"! ella lav mishshum dimheman?
Vedilma dishmaneh defaggel! i lav dimheman, af al gav dishmaneh name la meheman, dedilma levatar hachi kaamar.
Vedilma dachazeneh befishpash? kashya.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi amme, amar leh: sefer tora shekkatavti lifloni, azkarot shello lo ketavtim lishman. amar leh: sefer tora beyad mi? amar leh: beyad lokeach. amar leh: neeman atta lehafesid secharcha, vei atta neeman lehafesid sefer tora.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya: nehi dehifsid sechar azkarot, sechar desefer tora kulleh mi hifsid?! amar leh: in, shekkol sefer tora sheen azkarot shello ketuvot lishman – eno shave kelum.
Veliabbar alayyhu kulemos, velikaddesheh! keman – nema dela kerabbi yehuda?

Ditnan: hare shehaya tzarich lichtov et hashshem; venitkavvevn lichtov "yehuda", vetaa velo hetil bo dalet; maavir alav kulemos, umekaddesho, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: en hashshem min hammuvechar.
Afillu tema rabbi yehuda – ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda ella bachada azkara, aval dechulle sefer tora – la, mishshum demichaze kimnummar.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi avahu, amar leh: sefer tora shekkatavti lifloni, gevilin shello lo ibbadtim lishman. amar leh: sefer tora beyad mi? amar leh: beyad lokeach. amar lo: mittoch sheatta neeman lehafesid secharcha, atta neeman lehafesid sefer tora.

a: Umay shena midderabbi amme? hatam, ikka lememar tae bidrabbi yirmeya. hacha, kevan deka mafsed kulleh agreh – vaata vaamar, emor kusheta kaamar.
Mishna heid rabbi yochanan ben gudegda al hachereshet shehissiah aviha, shehi yotza beget;
Veal ketanna bat yisrael shennisset lechohen, sheochelet bitruma, veim meta – balah yorshah;
Veal hammarish haggazul shebbenao bevira, sheyyittol et damav, mippene takkanat hashshavim;
Veal chattat haggezula shello noda lerabbim – shehi mechapperet, mippene tikkun hammizbeach.

Gemara amar rava: meeduto shel rabbi yochanan ben gudegda – amar leedim: rau get ze sheani noten lah, vechazar veamar lah: kinsi shetar chov ze – hare zo megoreshet. mi la amar rabbi yochanan ben gudegda la baenan data? hacha name la baenan data.
Peshita! mahu detema, kevan deamar: "kinsi shetar chov ze", battole batteleh; ka mashma lan, im ita devatteleh – leedim hava amar lehu. vehay dekaamar hachi – mishshum kissufa.
Veal ketanna bat yisrael: veillu chereshet – la achla. may tama? gezera shemma yaachil cheresh bechereshet.
Veloychevl – katan ochel nevelot hu!
Gezera shemma yaachil cheresh befikkachat.
Velochevl bitruma derabbanan! gezera shemma ate leochole bitruma deorayyta.

Veal hammarish haggazul shebbenao: tanu rabbanan: gazal marish uvenao bevira – bet shammay omrim: mekakea kol habbira kullah umachzir marish livalav; uvet hillel omrim: en lo ella deme marish bilvad, mishshum takkanat hashshavin.
Veal chattat haggezula kulei: amar ulla: devar tora, ben noda uven lo noda – enah mechapperet;
May tama? yeush kedi la kane; uma taam amru: lo noda mechapperet? shello yehu kohanim atzevin.
Amri leh rabbanan leulla: vehaanan – "mippene tikkun hammizbeach" tenan? amar lahem: kevan dechohanim atzevin, nimtza mizbeach batel.
Verav yehuda amar: devar tora, ben noda ben lo noda – mechapperet; may tama? yeush kedi kane;
b: Uma taam amru noda enah mechapperet? shello yomru mizbeach ochel gezelot.
Bishlama leulla – hayeynu dekatane chattat. ella lerav yehuda – may irya chattat, afillu ola name!

La mibbaya kaamar – la mibbaya ola, dechalil hi; ella afillu chattat name, dechelev vadam hu desalek legabbe mizbeach, veiddach kohanim achli leh; afillu hachi gezur, shello yomru mizbeach ochel gezelot.
Tenan: al chattat haggezula shello noda lerabbim, shehi mechapperet – mippene tikkun hammizbeach. bishlama leulla – nicha, ella lerav yehuda – ippecha mibbee leh!
Hachi name kaamar: la noda – mechapperet, noda – enah mechapperet, mippene tikkun hammizbeach.

Metiv rava: ganav vehikdish, veachar kach tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume chefel, veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. vetane ala: bachutz ki hay gavvna – anush karet. vei amrat yeush kedi la kane, karet may avidteh?

Amar rav shezvi: karet middivrehem. achichu aleh – karet middivrehem mi ikka?! amar lehu rava: gavra rabba amar milleta, la techuchu ala; karet sheal yede divrehen bata lo – okmuha rabbanan birshuteh ki hechi delichayyayv ala.

Amar rava: ha vavday ka mibbaya li – ki okmuha rabbanan birshuteh, mishsheat geneva o mishsheat hekdeshah? lemay nafka minna? legizzoteha uvaldoteha. may? hadar amar rava: mistabbera – mishsheat hekdeshah, shello yehe chote niskar.

Mishna lo haya sikarikon bihuda baharuge milchama. meharuge hammilchama veelach, yesh bah sikarikon. ketzad? lakach missikarikon, vechazar velakach mibbaal habbayit, mikkacho batel. mibbaal habbayit, vechazar velakach missikarikon – mikkacho kayyaym.
Lakach min haish vechazar velakach min haishsha – mikkacho batel. min haishsha vechazar velakach min haish – mikkacho kayyaym. zo mishna rishona.
Bet din shel acharehem amru: hallokeach missikarikon, noten labbealim revia. ematay – bizman sheen beyadan likkach, aval yesh beyadan likkach – hen kodmin lechol adam.
Rabbi hoshiv bet din venimnu, sheim shahata bifne sikarikon shenem asar chodesh, kol hakkodem likkach – zacha; aval noten labbealim revia.
Gemara hasheta baharuge hammilchama lo haya bah sikarikon, meharuge milchama veelach, yesh bah sikarikon?!

Amar rav yehuda: "lo danu bah din sikarikon" kaamar. deamar rabbi assi: shalosh gezerot gazru. gezerta kammayyta: kol dela katel – liktelu. metziata: kol dekatel – layyte arba zuze. batrayyta: kol dekatel – liktelu. hilkach, kammayyta umetziata, kevan dekatli – aggav uneseh gamar umakne.
Batrayyta amri: haiddana lishkol, limchar tavana leh bedina.

Amar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "ashre adam mefached tamid umakshe libbo yippol beraa"? akkamtza uvar kamtza charuv yerushalayim, attarnegola vetarnegolta charuv tur malka, ashshaka derispak charuv better.
Akkamtza uvar kamtza charuv yerushalayim – dehahu gavra derachameh kamtza, uveel devaveh bar kamtza. avad seodta, amar leh leshammaeh: zil ayyti li kamtza. azal ayyti leh bar kamtza.
Ata, ashkecheh dahava yatev. amar leh: mikkede hahu gavra beel devave dehahu gavra hu, may baet hacha? kum pok! amar leh: hoil vaatay, shivkan veyahevna lach deme ma deachelna veshatena.

a: Amar leh: la. amar leh: yahevna lach deme palga disodtaych! amar leh: la. amar leh: yahevna lach deme kulla seodtaych! amar leh: la. nakteh bideh veokmeh veappekeh.

Amar: hoil vahavo yatvi rabbanan vela macho beh, shema minna ka nicha lehu, ezil echol behu kuretza be malka. azal amar leh lekesar: meradu bach yehudae! amar leh: mi yemar? amar leh: shaddar lehu kurebana, chazet i makrevin leh.
Azal shaddar bideh igla tilta. bahade dekaate sheda beh muma beniv sefatayim, veamri la bedukkin shebbaayin – ducheta dildidan have muma, uledidhu lav muma hu.

Sevur rabbanan lekaroveh mishshum shelom malchut. amar lehu rabbi zecharya ben avkulas: yomru baale mumin kerevin legabbe mizbeach! sevur lemikteleh dela lezil velema. amar lehu rabbi zecharya: yomru metil mum bakkodashim yehareg!
Amar rabbi yochanan: invevtanuto shel rabbi zecharya ben avkulas, hechriva et betenu, vesarfa et hechalenu, vehigletanוּ meartzenu.
Shaddar illavayyhu leneron kesar. ki kaate; sheda gira lemizrach – ata nefal birushalayim. lemaarav – ata nefal birushalayim. learba ruchot hashshamayim – ata nefal birushalayim.

Amar leh leyanoka: pesok li pesukaych. amar leh: "venatatti et nikmati beedom beyad ammi yisrael vegomer". amar: kudesha berich hu bae lacharove beteh, uvae lechappore yedeh behahu gavra. arak vaazal veiggayyayr, unefak minneh rabbi meir.

Shaddereh illavayyhu leaspasyaynus kesar. ata, tzar ala telat shene. havo ba hanhu telata attire: nakdimon ben gureyon, uven kalba savua, uven tzitzit hakkeset. nakdimon ben gureyon – shennakda lo chamma baavuro. ben kalba savua, shekkol hannichnas leveto keshehu raev kechelev, yotze keshehu savea. ben tzitzit hakkeset – shehayta tzitzato nigreret al gabbe kesatot. ikka deamri: shehayta kisto muttelet ben gedole romi.

Chad amar lehu: ana zayenna lehu bechitte useare, vechad amar lehu: bidchamra uvidmilcha umishcha, vechad amar lehu: bidtzive. veshabbachu rabbanan lidtzive, derav chisda kol aklide hava masar leshammaeh, bar middetzive. deamar rav chisda: achalba dechitte bae shittin achalbe detzive. hava lehu lemezan esrim vechad shatta.

Havo behu hanhu biryone, amaru lehu rabbanan: nippok venaaved shelama bahadayyhu. la shavkinhu. amaru lehu: nippok venaaved kerava bahadayyhu, amaru lehu rabbanan: la mistayyeya milleta. kamu kelonhu lehanhu ambare dechitte useare, vahava kafna.

Marta bat bayytos attirta dirushalayim haveya. shaddarte lishlucha, vaamara leh: zil ayyti li semida. addaazal izdabban. ata amar la: semida lekka, chivvarta ikka. amara leh: zil ayyti li. addaazal izdabban. ata vaamar la: chivvarta lekka, gushekra ikka. amara leh: zil ayyti li. addaazal izdabban. ata vaamar la: gushekra lekka, kimcha disare ikka. amara leh: zil ayyti li. addaazal izdabban.
Hava shelifa mesana, amara: ippok veechze i mashkachna midde lemechal. itiv la parta bechara, umita.

Kare ala rabban yochanan ben zakkay: "harakka vecha vehaanugga asher lo nisseta chaf raglah". ikka deamri: gerogeret derabbi tzadok achala, veittenisa umita. derabbi tzadok yetev arbein shenin betaanita dela lecharev yerushalayim, ki hava achel midde hava mitchaze meabbaray. vechi hava bare, mayyti leh gerogrot, mayetz mayyayhu veshade lehu.
Ki hava ka nicha nafsha, appikte lechol dahava vechaspa shedeteh beshuka, amara: hay lemay mibbee li! vehayeynu dichtiv: "kaspam bechutzot yashlichu".

Abba sikra – resh biryone dirushalayim, bar achateh derabban yochanan ben zakkay hava. shelach leh: ta betzina legabbay. ata. amar leh: ad emat avditu hachi, vekatlitu leh lealma bechafna? amar leh: may eeved, dei amena lehu midde katlu li! amar leh: chazi li takkanta ledidi deeppok, efshar dehave hatztzala pureta.

Amar leh: nekot nafshach biktzire, veleto kulle alma velishayyeylu bach, veayyti midde sarya veagni gabbach, velemru denach nafshach. veliayyeylu bach talmidach vela leul bach inish acharina, dela largeshun bach dekallil at, deinhu yadi dechayyay kallil mimmita.

Aved hachi. nichnas bo rabbi eliezer mitztzad echad, verabbi yehoshua mitztzad acher. ki meto lefitcha, beo lemidkereh. amar lehu: yomru: rabban dakru! beo lemidchafeh. amar lehu: yomru: rabban dachafu! petachu leh bava, nefak.

Ki meta lehatam, amar: shelama alach malka, shelama alach malka. amar leh: michayyeyvat tere (ketala) [katli], chada delav malka ana veka karet li malka, vetu i malka ana ad haiddana ammay la atet legabbay. amar leh: dekaamrat lav malka ana,
b: Ivra malka at; dei lav malka at la mimmasra yerushalayim bidach, dichtiv: "vehallevanon beaddir yippol" – veen "addir" ella melech, dichtiv: "vehaya addiro mimmennu vegomer"; veen "levanon" ella bet hammikdash, shenneemar: "hahar hattov hazze vehallevanon". udekaamrat: i malka ana, ammay la kaatet legabbay ad haiddana – biryone deit ban la shavkinan.

Amar leh: illu chavit shel devash uderakon karuch aleha, lo hayu shovrin et hechavit bishvil derakon? ishtik. kare aleh rav yosef, veittema rabbi akiva: "meshiv chachamim achor vedatam yesakkel", ibbei leh lememar leh: shaklinan tzevata veshaklinan leh lidrakon vekatlinan leh, vechavita shavkinan la.

Addehachi, ata peresteka aleh meromi, amar leh: kum, demit leh kesar, veamri hanhu chashive deromi leotoyvacha beresha. hava sayem chad (mesane) [mesaneh]. bea lemisyeyme leacharina, la ayel. bea lemishlefeh leiddach, la nefak. amar: may hay?

Amar leh: la titztaar, shemua tova atya lach, dichtiv: "shemua tova tedashshen atzem". ella may takkanteh? lete inish dela meyatteva datach minneh, velachaloyf kammach, dichtiv: "veruach nechea teyabbesh garem". avad hachi, ayayl. amar leh: umeachar dechachmitu kulle hay, ad haiddana ammay la atetu legabbay? amar leh: vela amari lach?! amar leh: ana name amari lach!

Amar leh: mezal azelna, veinash acharina meshaddarna; ella bae minnay midde deetten lach. amar leh: ten li yavne vachachameha, veshushilta derabban gamliel, veasvota demassayin leh lerabbi tzadok. kare aleh rav yosef, veittema rabbi akiva: "meshiv chachamim achor vedatam yesakkel", ibbei lememar leh: lishbekinhu hada zimna.
Vehu savar: dilma kulle hay la aved, vehatztzala pureta name la have.
Asvota demassayin leh lerabbi tzadok – may hi? yoma kamma ashkeyu mayya defare, limchar mayya desippuka, limchar mayya dekimcha, ad dirvavch meyeh pureta pureta.
Azal shaddareh letitus. "veamar e elohemo tzur chasayu vo" – ze titus harasha shecheraf vegiddef kelappe mala.

Ma asa? tafas zona beyado venichnas levet kodshe hakkodashim, vehitztzia sefer tora veavar aleha avera. venatal sayif vegidder et happarochet, venaasa nes vehaya dam mevatzbetz veyotze, uchesavur harag et atzmo, shenneemar: "shaagu tzorrecha bekerev moadecha samu ototam otot".

Abba chanan omer: "mi chamocha chasin yah" – mi chamocha chasin vekashe, sheatta shomea niutzo vegiddufo shel oto rasha, veshotek. deve rabbi yishmael tana: "mi kamocha baelim Adonai" – mi kamocha baillemim.

Ma asa? natal et happarochet vaasao kemin garguteni, vehevi kol kelim shebbammikdash vehinnichan bahen, vehoshivan bisfina lelech lehishtabbeach beiro, shenneemar: "uvechen raiti reshaim kevurim vavau, umimmekom kadosh yehallechu, veyishtakkechu vair asher ken asu" – al tikre "kevurim" ella "kevutzim"; al tikre "veyishtakkechu" ella "veyishtabbechu".
Ikka deamri, kevurim mammash – daafillu mille demittammeran, iggalyayn lehon.

Amad alav nachshol shebbayyam letovo, amar: kimdumme ani sheelohehem shel ellu, en gevurato ella bammayim; ba paro – tevao bammayim, ba sisra – tevao bammayim; af hu omed alay letoveni bammayim. im gibbor hu, yaale layyabbasha veyaase immi milchama! yatzta bat kol veamra lo: rasha ben rasha ben beno shel esav harasha, beriyya kalla yesh li beolami, veyattush shemah.
Ammay kare la "beriyya kalla"? demaalana it la, umappekana let la.

Ale layyabbasha vetaase immah milchama. ala layyabbasha, ba yattush venichnas bechotmo, venikker bemocho sheva shanim. yoma chad hava ka chalef abbava deve nappacha, shema kal arzafta, ishtik; amar: ikka takkanta. kol yoma mayytu nappacha umachu kamme. legoy – yahev leh arba zuze, yisrael – amar leh: missatyaych deka chazet besanach. ad telatin yomin avad hachi; mikkan veelach, kevan dedash, dash.
Tanya, amar rabbi pinchas ben aruva: ani hayiti ben gedole romi, ucheshemmet patzu et mocho, umatzu bo ketzippor deror mishkal shene selaim. bematnita tana: kegozal ben shana – mishkal shene litrin.
Amar abbaye: naktinan, piv shel nechoshet vetzippornav shel barzel. ki hava ka mayet, amar lehu: likleyu lehahu gavra uvaddaru lekitmeh ashshav yammi, dela lashkecheh elaha dihudae velokmeh bedina.

Uneklos bar kelonikus bar achateh detitus hava. bae leiggayyore, azal assekeh letitus bingida, amar leh: man chashiv behahu alma? amar leh: yisrael. mahu leiddabboke behu? amar leh: millayyhu nefishin, vela matzet lekayyominhu. zil iggari behu behahu alma vehavet resha, dichtiv: "hayu tzareha lerosh vegomer" – kol hammetzar leyisrael naasa rosh. amar leh: dineh dehahu gavra bemay? amar leh:

a: Bemay difsayk annafsheh – kol yoma mechanneshi leh lekitmeh vedayyni leh, vekalu leh umevadderu [leh] ashshav yamme.

Azal assekeh levilam bingida, amar leh: man chashiv behahu alma? amar leh: yisrael. mahu leiddabboke behu? amar leh: "lo tidrosh shelomam vetovatam kol hayyamim". amar leh: dineh dehahu gavra bemay? amar leh: beshichvat zera rotachat.

Azal assekeh bingida leyeshu hannotzri, amar leh: man chashiv behahu alma? amar leh: yisrael. mahu leiddabboke behu? amar leh: tovatam derosh, raatam lo tidrosh, kol hannogea bahen keillu nogea bevavat eno.
Amar leh: dineh dehahu gavra bemay? amar leh: betzoa rotachat. deamar mar: kol hammalig al divre chachamim niddon betzoa rotachat. ta chazi ma ben poshe yisrael linvie ummot haolam.
Tanya, amar rabbi elazar: bo uree kamma gadol(5) kochah shel busha, shehare siyyay hakkadosh baruch hu et bar kamtza, vehechriv et beto, vesaraf et hechalo.
Attarnegola veattarnegolta chariv tur malka: dahavo nehigi ki havo mappeki chatna vechalleta, mappeki kammayyhu tarnegola vetarnegolta, kelomar: peru urevu ketarnegolim.

Yoma chad hava ka chalef guneda deromae, shaklinhu minnayyhu. nefalu alayyhu mechonhu. ato amaru leh lekesar: meradu bach yehudae! ata alayyhu. hava behu hahu bar daroma, dahava kafetz mila vekatel behu. shakleh kesar letageh veotveh aara. amar: ribboneh dealma kulleh, i nicha lach, la timsereh lehahu gavra – ledideh ulemalchuteh, bideh dechad gavra!
Achsheleh pummeh levar daroma, vaamar: "halo atta elohim zenachtanu velo tetze elohim betzivotenu". david name amar hachi! david atmohe ka matma.

Al levet hakkisse, ata derakona shamteh lecharkesheh venach nafsheh. amar: hoil veitrechish li nissa, ha zimna eshbekinhu. shavkinhu vaazal. izdekur vaachalu usheto, veadliku sherage, ad deitchazi bilyona degushepanka berachok mila. amar: michda ka chadu bi yehudae! hadar ata alayyhu.
Amar rabbi assi: telat mea alfe shelife sayyfa ayaylu letur malka, uketalu ba telata yome utelata lelavota; uvehach gisa hillule vechinge, vela havo yadi hane behane.

"Billa Adonai velo chamal et kol neot yaakov" – ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: ellu shishshim ribbo ayayrot shehayu lo leyannay hammelech behar hammelech. deamar rav yehuda amar rav assi: shishshim ribbo ayayrot hayu lo leyannay hammelech behar hammelech, vechol achat veachat hayu bah keyotze mitzrayim, chutz mishshalosh shehayu bahen kiflayim keyotze mitzrayim.

Ellu hen: kefar bish, kefar shaychalayim, kefar dichrayya. kefar bish – dela yahavi beta leushepiza. kefar shaychalayim – shehayta parnasatan min shachalayim. kefar dichrayya – amar rabbi yochanan: shehayu neshotehen yoldot zecharim techilla, veyoldot nekeva baacharona, ufoskot.

Amar ulla: ledidi chaze li hahu atra, vaafillu shittin ribbevota kene la machzek. amar leh hahu mina lerabbi chanina: shakkore meshakkeritu! amar leh: "eretz tzevi" ketiv ba, ma tzevi ze – en oro machazik et besaro, af eretz yisrael – bizman sheyyoshvin aleha ravvcha, uvizman sheen yoshvin aleha gamda.
Rav minyome bar chilkiyya verav chilkiyya bar toviyya verav huna bar chiyyay havu yatvi gabbe hadade, amri: i ikka dishmia leh milleta mikkefar sechanya shel mitzrayim, lema.
Petach chad minnayyhu vaamar: maase bearus vaarusato shennishbu leven haggoyim, vehissium ze laze. amra lo: "bevakkasha mimmecha, al tigga bi, sheen li ketubba mimmecha", velo naga bah ad yom moto.

Ucheshemmet, amra lahen: sifdu laze, sheppitpet beyitzro yoter miyyosef; deillu beyosef la hava ella chada shata, vehay kol yoma veyoma. veillu yosef lav bachada mitta, vehay bachada mitta. veillu yosef lav ishto, veha ishto.

Petach iddach vaamar: maase veamdu arbaim modiyyot bedinar; nechsar hashshaar modya achat, uvadku, umatzu av uveno shebbau al naara meorasa beyom hakkippurim; vehevium levet din usekalum, vechazar hashshaar limkomo.

Petach iddach vaamar: maase beadam echad shennatan enav beishto legarshah, vehayta ketubbatah merubba. ma asa? halach vezimmen et shoshvinav veheechilan vehishkan, shikkeran vehishkivan al mitta achat, vehevi loven betza vehittil benehen, veheemid lahen edim, uva levet din.

Haya sham zaken echad mittalmide shammay hazzaken, uvava ben buta shemo. amar lahen, kach mekubbelani mishshammay hazzaken: loven betza soled min haur, veshichvat zera docha min haur. badku umatzu kidvarav, veheviuhu levet din vehilkuhu, vehigbuhu ketubbatah mimmennu.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: umeachar dahavo tzaddikim kulle hay, may tama ianush? amar leh: mishshum dela iabbul al yerushalayim, dichtiv: "simchu et yerushalam vegilu vah kol ohaveha, sisu ittah masos kol hammitabbelim aleha".

Ashshaka derispak chariv better: dahavo nehigi ki hava mityelid yanoka – shatli arza, yanokta – shatli turenita; vechi havo minnasvi, kayytzi lehu veavdi genana. yoma chad hava ka chalfa beratte dekesar, ittevar shaka derispak. katztzu arza veayyilu la. ato neful alayyhu mechonhu. ato amaru leh lekesar: meradu bach yehudae! ata alayyhu.

"Gada bochori af kol keren yisrael" – amar rabbi zera amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: ellu shemonim [elef] karne milchama shennichnesu lichrach better beshaa shellechaduha, vehargu bah anashim venashim vataf, ad shehalach daman venafal layyam haggadol. shemma tomar kerova hayta? rechoka hayta mil.

Tanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: shene nechalim yesh bevikat yadayim, echad moshech elach, veechad moshech elach, veshiaru chachamim shene chalakim mayim veechad dam. bematnita tana: sheva shanim batzru goyim et karmehen middaman shel yisrael, belo zevel.
b: Amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha, sach li zaken echad meanshe yerushalayim: bevika zo harag nevuzaradan rav tabbachim matayim veachat esre ribbo, uvirushalayim harag tishim vearba ribbo al even achat, ad shehalach daman venaga bedamo shel zecharya, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "vedamim bedamim nagu".
Ashkecheh lidmeh dizcharya dahava ka mirtach vesalek, amar: may hay? amaru leh: dam zevachim deishtefuch. ayyti deme vela iddemo.

Amar lehu: i amritu li – mutav, vei lav – mesarekna levisrayychu bemasreke defarzele. amri leh: may nema lach? neviyyay hava ban dahava ka mochach lan bemille dishmayya, kamynan illaveh uketalynan leh, veha kamma shenin dela ka nayaych demeh.

Amar lehu: ana mefayyesna leh. ayyti sanhedri gedola vesanhedri ketanna ketal illaveh, vela nach. bachurim uvetulot ketal illaveh, vela nach. ayyti tinokot shel bet rabban ketal illaveh, vela nach. amar leh: zecharya, zecharya, tovim shebbahen ibbadtim, nicha lach deovdinhu lechullehu? kedaamar leh hachi, nach.
Behahi shata harehar teshuva bedateh, amar: uma im al nefesh achat, kach; hahu gavra diktal kol hane nishmata – al achat kamma vechamma! arak, azal shaddar shetar pirteta beveteh, veiggayyayr.
Tana: naaman ger toshav haya; nevuzaradan ger tzedek haya;
Mibbene vanav shel haman limmedu tora bivne verak; mibbene vanav shel sisra limmedu tinokot birushalayim; mibbene vanav shel sancheriv limmedu tora barabbim – man innun? shemaya veavtalyon.
Hayeynu dichtiv: "natatti et damah al tzechiach sala levilti hikkasot".

"Hakkol kol yaakov vehayyadayim yede esav" – "hakkol", ze adriyyaynus kesar, sheharag baalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim shishshim ribbo al shishshim ribbo, kiflayim keyotze mitzrayim. "kol yaakov" – ze aspasyaynus kesar, sheharag bichrach better arba meot ribbo, veamri la: arbaat alafim ribbo. "vehayyadayim yede esav" – zo malchut harshaa, shehechriva et battenu, vesarfa et hechalenu, vehigletanוּ meartzenu.
Davar acher: "hakkol kol yaakov" – en lecha tefilla shemmoelet, sheen bah mizzaro shel yaakov. "vehayyadayim yede esav" – en lecha milchama shennotzachat, sheen bah mizzaro shel esav.

Vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar: "beshot lashon techave" – bechirchure lashon techave. amar rav yehuda amar rav, may dichtiv: "al naharot bavel, sham yashavnu gam bachinu bezochrenu et tziyyon"? melammed sheherahu hakkadosh baruch hu ledavid chureban bayit rishon vechureban bayit sheni. chureban bayit rishon – shenneemar: "al naharot bavel sham yashavnu gam bachinu". bayit sheni – dichtiv: "zechor Adonai livne edom et yom yerushalaym, haomrim aru aru ad hayesod bah".

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, veittema rabbi amme, veamri la bematnita tana: maase bearba meot yeladim viladot shennishbu lekalon, hirgishu beatzman lema hen mitbakkeshim, amru: im anu tovin bayyam – anu bain lechayye haolam habba? darash lahen haggadol shebbahen: "amar Adonai mibbashan ashiv, ashiv mimmetzulot yam" – "mibbashan ashiv", mibben shinne arye; "ashiv mimmetzulot yam", ellu shettovin bayyam.

Kevan sheshshamu yeladot kach, kaftzu kullan venaflu letoch hayyam. nasu yeladim kal vachomer beatzman, veamru: ma hallalu, sheddarkan lechach – kach; anu, sheen darkenu lechach – al achat kamma vechamma! af hem kaftzu letoch hayyam. vaalehem hakkatuv omer: "ki alecha horagnu chol hayyom, nechshavnu ketzon tivcha".
Verav yehuda amar: zo ishsha veshiva baneha – atyu lekamma lekammeh dekesar, amaru leh: pelach laavoda zara! amar lehu, katuv battora: "anochi Adonai elohecha". appeku vekatlu.

Atyu leiddach lekammeh dekesar, amaru leh: pelach laavoda zara! amar lehu, katuv battora: "lo yihye lecha elohim acherim al panay". appeku vekatlu. atyu leiddach, amaru leh: pelach laavoda zara! amar lehu, katuv battora: "zoveach lelohim yochoram". appeku vekatlu.

Atyu leiddach, amaru leh: pelach laavoda zara! amar lehu, katuv battora: "lo tishtachave leel acher". appeku vekatlu. atyu leiddach, amaru leh: pelach laavoda zara! amar lehu, katuv battora: "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad". appeku vekatlu.

Atyu leiddach, amaru leh: pelach laavoda zara! amar lehu, katuv battora: "veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha, ki Adonai hu haelohim bashshamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat, en od". appeku vekatlu.

Atyu leiddach, amaru leh: pelach laavoda zara! amar lehu, katuv battora: "et Adonai heemarta vegomer vaAdonai heemircha hayyom", kevar nishbanu lehakkadosh baruch hu sheen anu maavirin oto beel acher, veaf hu nishba lanu sheen maavir otanu beumma acheret.

Amar leh kesar: eshde lach gushepanka ugechen veshikleh, ki hechi delemru: kabbel aleh haremana demalka. amar leh: chaval alach kesar, chaval alach kesar; al kevod atzmecha kach, al kevod hakkadosh baruch hu al achat kamma vechamma!

Appeku lemikteleh, amara lehu immeh: yahavu nihali veenashshekeh pureta. amra lo: banayy, lechu veimru leavraham avichem: atta akadta mizbeach echad vaani akadti shiva mizbechot! af hi alta laggag venafla umeta. yatzta bat kol veamra: "em habbanim semecha".

Rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: zo mila shennittena bashshemini. rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: ellu talmide chachamim shemmarin hilchot shechita beatzman, deamar rava: kol mille lichze inish benafsheh, bar mishshechita vedavar acher.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: ellu talmide chachamim shemmemitin atzman al divre tora, kidrabbi shimon ben lakish – deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: en divre tora mitkayyeymin ella bemi shemmemit atzmo alehem, shenneemar: "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel vegomer". amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: arbaim sea

a: Ketzutze tefillin nimtzeu berashe haruge vetter. rabbi yannay berabbi yishmael amar: shalosh kuppot shel arbaim arbaim sea. bematnita tana: arbaim kuppot shel shalosh shalosh sein.
Vela peligi: ha deresha, ha didraa.

Amar rabbi assi: arbaa kabbin moach nimtzeu al even achat. ulla amar: tishat kabbin. amar rav kahana veittema shela bar mari: may keraa? "bat bavel hashsheduda, ashre sheyshallem lach vegomer, ashre sheyyochez venippetz et olalayich el hassala".

"Bene tziyyon hayekarim hamesullaim bappaz" – may "mesullaim bappaz"? illema dahavo mechappi befizza, vehaamri deve rabbi shela: tarte matkale istere pizza nechut bealma – chada beromi, vachada bechulle alma! ella shehayu megannin et happaz beyofyayn.
Meikkara, chashivi deromae havo nakti bilyona degushepanka, umeshammeshi arsayyhu; mikkan veelach, mayytu bene yisrael veasri bechare defurayyhu, umeshammeshi.

Amar leh chad lechavreh: ha, hecha ketiva? amar leh: "gam kol choli vechol makka asher lo chatuv besefer hattora hazzot". amar: kamma merachaykna midducheta pelan? amar leh: inneged puseta ufalga. amar leh: i metay legabbeh la itzterichi lach.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel, may dichtiv: "eni olla lenafshi mikkol benot iri"? arba meot batte chenesiyyot hayu bichrach better, uvechol achat veachat hayu bah arba meot melammede tinokot, vechol echad veechad hayu lefanav arba meot tinokot shel bet rabban,
Ucheshehaya oyev nichnas lesham hayu dokrin otan bechotrehen. uchesheggavar oyev ulechadum, kerachum besifrehem vehitztzitum baesh.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi yehoshua ben chananya shehalach lichrach gadol shebberomi, amru lo: tinok echad yesh bevet haasurim, yefe enayim vetov roi ukevutztzotav sedurot lo taltallim. halach veamad al petach bet haasurim, amar: "mi natan limshissa yaakov veyisrael levozzim"? ana oto tinok veamar: "halo Adonai zu chatanu lo velo avu vidrachav haloch velo shamu betorato".

Amar: muvetchani bo shemmore horaa beyisrael, haavoda! sheeni zaz mikkan ad sheefdennu bechol mamon shepposkin alav. amru: lo zaz mishsham ad sheppedao bemamon harebe, velo hayu yamim muatin ad shehora horaa beyisrael. umannu? rabbi yishmael ben elisha.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: maase bivno uvevitto shel rabbi yishmael ben elisha shennishbu lishne adonim. leyamim nizdavvevgu shenehem bimkom echad, ze omer: yesh li eved sheen keyofyo bechol haolam, veze omer: yesh li shifcha sheen bechol haolam kullo keyofyah.

Amru: bo venassiem ze laze, unechallek bavvevladot. hichnisum lecheder. ze yashav bekeren zavit ze, vezo yashva bekeren zavit ze, ze omer: ani, kohen ben kohanim gedolim, essa shifcha?! vezot omeret: ani, kohenet bat kohanim gedolim, ennase leeved?! uvachu kol hallayla.
Kevan sheala ammud hashshachar, hikkiru ze et ze, venaflu ze al ze vegau bivchiyya ad sheyyatza nishmatan. vaalehen konen yirmeya: "al elle ani vochiyya, eni eni yorda mayim".
Amar resh lakish: maase beishsha achat, vetzafnat bat peniel shemah; "tzafnat" – shehakkol tzofin beyofyah, "bat peniel" – bitto shel kohen gadol sheshshimmesh lifnay velifnim;

Shennitallel bah shabbay kol hallayla. lemachar hilbishah shiva chalukim, vehotziah lemochrah. ba adam echad shehaya mechoar beyoter, amar lo: hareeni et yofyah. amar lo: reka! im atta rotze likkach – kach, sheen keyofyah bechol haolam kullo.

Amar lo: af al pi chen. hifshitah shishsha chalukim, ushevii keraattu venitpallesha baefer, amra lefanav: ribbono shel olam, im alenu lo chasta, al kedushshat shimcha (haggibbor) [haggadol] lamma lo tachus.

Vealeha konen yirmeya: "bat ammi chigri sak vehitpalleshi vaefer, evel yachid asi lach mispad tamrurim, ki fitom yavo hashshoded alenu" – "alayich" lo neemar, ella "alenu"; kivyachol, alay vealayich ba shoded.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav, may dichtiv: "veashku gever uveto veish venachalato"? maase beadam echad shennatan enav beeshet rabbo, ushevalya denaggare hava.

Paam achat hutzerach (rabbo) lilvot, amar lo: shagger ishtecha etzli vealvenna. shigger ishto etzlo, shaha immah shelosha yamim. kadam uva etzlo, amar lo: ishti sheshshiggarti lecha hechan hi? amar lo: ani petartiha lealtar, veshamati shehattinokot nitallelu bah badderech.
Amar lo: ma eese? amar lo: im atta shomea laatzati, garshah. amar lo: ketubbatah merubba. amar lo: ani alvevcha veten lah ketubbatah. amad ze vegershah, halach hu unesaah.

Kevan shehiggia zemanno velo haya lo leforo, amar lo: bo vaase immi bechovcha. vehayu hem yoshvim veochlim veshotin, vehu haya omed umashke alehen, vehayu demaot noshrot meenav venoflot bechosehen. veal otah shaa nitchattem gezar din. veamri la: al shete fetilot bener echad.
Lakach min hassikarikon vechulei: amar rav: lo shanu ella deamar lo: "lech, chazek ukeni", aval bishtar – kana. ushemuel amar: af bishtar name lo kana, ad sheyyichtov lo achrayut.
b: Tanya kevoteh dishmuel, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: lakach min haishsha, vechazar velakach min haish – mikkacho kayyaym. min haish, vechazar velakach min haishsha – mikkacho batel, ad shettichtov lo achrayut.
Nema tehve teyuveta derav? amar lecha rav: may "achrayut" – name shetar.
Tanu rabbanan: lakach min hassikarikon, vaachalah shalosh shanim bifne bealim, vechazar umecharah leacher – en labbealim al lokeach sheni kelum.
Hechi dame? i deka taen veamar: "minnach zavna" – afillu rishon name! i dela ka taen veamar: "minnach zavna", afillu sheni name la!
Amar rav sheshet: leolam dela ka taen leh, uchegon ze – toanin leyoresh, vetoanin lelokeach.
Veiddach, i taen – in, vei la taen – la.
Tanu rabbanan: habba mechamat chov umechamat anparut – en bo mishshum sikarikon, veanparut atzmah – tzericha shettishhe shenem asar chodesh.
Vehaamrat en bah mishshum sikarikon! hachi kaamar: sikarikon atzmah – tzericha shettishhe shenem asar chodesh.
Amar rav yosef, naktinan: en anparut bevavel. veha kachazenan deikka! ella ema: en din anparut bevavel. may tama? kevan deikka be dauor vela azel kavel, ema achole achel.
Giddul bar reilay kabbel ara betaska mibbene vaga. akdem veyahev zuze ditlat shenin. lesof ata marvota kammae, amaru leh: shatta kammayyta dihavt – achalt, hasheta anan yahavinan – anan achlinan.

Ato lekammeh derav pappa, savar michtav leh tirfa abbene vaga. amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: im ken, asita sikarikon! ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hinniach meotav al keren hatztzevi.
Zo mishna rishona. bet din shel acharehen amru: hallokeach min hassikarikon noten labbealim revia: amar rav: revia bekarka, o revia bemaot. ushemuel amar: revia bekarka – shehen shelish bemaot.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: neche revia zaven, umar savar: neche chumesha zaven.

Metivi: zo mishna rishona. bet din shel acharehen amru: hallokeach min hassikarikon, noten labbealim revia, veyad bealim al haelyona – ratzu bekarka notlin, ratzu bemaot notlin. ematay – bizman sheen beyadan likkach, aval yesh beyadan likkach – hen kodmin lechol adam.
Rabbi hoshiv bet din venimnu, sheim shahata bifne sikarikon shenem asar chodesh, kol hakkodem likkach – zacha, aval noten labbealim revia bekarka o revia bemaot!
Amar rav ashe: ki tanya hahi, leachar shebbau maot leyado. amar rav:

a: Ana havay beminyayna deve rabbi, uminnay didi meno beresha.
Vehaanan tenan: dine mamonot vehatteharot vehattemaot – matchilin min haggadol, vedine nefashot matchilin min hatztzad!
Amar rabba bereh derava, veittema rabbi hillel bereh derabbi vavlas: shane minyana deve rabbi, dechullehu minyanayyhu min hatztzad havo matchilin.
Veamar rabba bereh derava, veittema rabbi hillel bereh derabbi voles: mimot moshe vead rabbi lo matzinu tora ugedulla bemakom echad.
Vela?! ha hava yehoshua! hava elazar. ha hava elazar! hava pinchas. veha hava pinchas! havo zekenim.
Ha hava shaul! hava shemuel. veha nach nafsheh! kullehu shene kaamrinan. veha hava david! hava ira hayyairi.
Veha nach nafsheh! kullehu shene baenan. ha hava shelomo! hava shimi ben gera. veha katleh! kullehu shene kaamrinan.
Ha hava chizkiyya! hava shevna. ha ikketil! kullehu shene kaamrinan. veha hava ezra! hava nechemya ben chachalya.
Amar rav acha bereh derava: af ani omer, mimot rabbi vead rav ashe lo matzinu tora ugedulla bemakom echad. vela?! veha hava huna bar natan! shane huna bar natan, demechaf hava kayif leh lerav ashe.
Mishna cheresh romez venirmaz. uven betira omer: kofetz venikpatz – bemittaltelin. happaotot mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar – bemittaltelin.
Gemara amar rav nachman: machaloket bemittaltelin, aval begittin – divre hakkol birmiza.
Peshita, "bemittaltelin" tenan! mahu detema "af bemittaltelin", ka mashma lan.
Ikka deamri, amar rav nachman: kemachloket bemittaltelin kach machloket begittin. vehaanan "bemittaltelin" tenan! ema: "af bemittaltelin".

Happaotot mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar – bemittaltelin. vead kamma? machve rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh: kevar shet – kevar shav. rav kahana amar: kevar shav – kevar tamne. bematnita tana: kevar tesha – kevar eser.
Vela peligi; kol chad vechad lefi churepeh. vetama may? amar rabbi abba bar yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: mishshum kede chayyav.
"Vayyomer laasher al hammeltacha, hotze levush lechol ovde habbaal" – may "meltacha"? amar rabbi abba bar yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: devar hannimlal venimtach.

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: shigger lo buneyaym ben nuneyaym lerabbi – sivni, vechomes, salsala, umalmala. sivni vechomes – keamguza ufalgeh deamguza. salsala umalmala – kefisteka ufalgu defisteka. may malmala? davar hannimlal venimtach.
Vetautan ad kamma? amar rabbi yona amar rabbi zera: ad shetut kegadol.
Bae abbaye: mattenato, may? rav yemar amar: en mattenato mattana; mar bar rav ashe amar: mattenato mattana.

Afchuha veshadderuha lekammeh derav mordochay. amar leh: zilu emaru levar mar, lav hachi hava ovada? ki hava kae mar – chad kareh aara vechad kareh addarga, vaamarna leh: mattenato may? vaamar lan: mattenato mattana – achat mattenat shechiv mera veachat mattenat bari, achat mattana merubba veachat mattana muetet.
Mishna ellu devarim amru mippene darche shalom: kohen kore rishon, veacharav levi veacharav yisrael – mippene darche shalom. mearvin bevayit yashan – mippene darche shalom.
b: Bor shehu karov laamma mitmalle rishon – mippene darche shalom.
Metzudot chayya veofot vedagim, yesh bahen mishshum gazel – mippene darche shalom; rabbi yose omer: gazel gamur.
Metziat cheresh shote vekatan, yesh bahen mishshum gazel – mippene darche shalom; rabbi yose omer: gazel gamur.
Ani hamenakkef berosh hazzayit, ma shettachtav gazel – mippene darche shalom; rabbi yose omer: gazel gamur.
En memachin beyad aniyye goyim beleket shichcha ufea – mippene darche shalom.

Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav matna, deamar kera: "vayyichtov moshe et hattora hazzot vayyittenah el hakkohanim bene levi" – attu ana la yadana dechohanim, bene levi ninhu? ella kohen beresha, vahadar levi.
Rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar, mehacha: "veniggeshu hakkohanim bene levi" – attu anan la yadinan dechohanim, bene levi ninhu? ella kohen beresha, vahadar levi.
Rav ashe amar mehacha: "bene amram aharon umoshe, vayyibbadel aharon lehakedisho kodesh kodashim".

Rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar mehacha: "vekiddashto" – lechol davar shebbikdushsha. tana deve rabbi yishmael: "vekiddashto" – lechol davar shebbikdushsha; liftoach rishon, ulevarech rishon, velittol mana yafa rishon.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: mippene darche shalom?! deorayyta hi! amar leh: deorayyta, umippene darche shalom.
Kol hattora kullah name mippene darche shalom hi, dichtiv: "deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom"!

Ella amar abbaye: lechidmar; detanya: shenayim – mamtinin ze laze bakkeara. shelosha – en mamtinin. habbotzea – hu poshet yado techilla, veim ba lachlok kavod lerabbo o lemi sheggadol mimmennu – harshut beyado.
Veamar mar ala: lo shanu ella bisuda, aval bevet hakkeneset lo, deatu leinnetzoye.
Amar rav matna: ha deamrat bevet hakkeneset lo, la amaran ella beshabbatot veyamim tovim – dishchichi rabbim, aval besheni uvachamishi – la.
Ini?! veha rav huna kare bechahane beshabbatot veyom tov! shane rav huna, daafillu rabbi amme verabbi assi – kahane chashivi deeretz yisrael – mechaf havo kayyfi leh.
Amar abbaye, naktinan: en sham kohen – nitparda chavila. veamar abbaye, naktinan: en sham levi – kore kohen.
Ini?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: kohen achar kohen lo yikra, mishshum pegamo shel rishon. levi achar levi lo yikra mishshum pegam shenehem! ki kaamrinan, beoto kohen.
May shena levi achar levi, deikka pegam shenehem – deamri: chad minnayyhu lav levi hu; kohen acher kohen name, amri: chad minnayyhu lav kohen hu! kegon demuchezak lan baavu dehay sheni, dechohen hu.
Hacha name, demuchezak lan baavu dehay sheni, delevi hu! ella amri: mamzeret o netina nesev, ufasleh lezareh. hacha name, amri: gerusha o chalutza nesev, veachaleh lezareh!
Sof sof, levi mi ka have?!
Uleman? i leyoshvin – ha ka chazu leh! ella leyotzin.
Shelachu leh bene galila lerabbi chelbo: acharehen,

a: Mi korin? la hava bideh. ata veshayyleh lerabbi yitzchak nappacha, amar leh: acharehen korin talmide chachamim hamemunnin parnasim al hatztzibbur, veacharehen talmide chachamim haruyin lemannotam parnasim al hatztzibbur, veacharehen bene talmide chachamim sheavotehen memunnim parnasim al hatztzibbur, veacharehen rashe chenesiyyot vechol adam.

Shelachu leh bene galil lerabbi chelbo: mahu likrot bechummashim bevet hakkeneset betzibbur? la hava bideh. ata shayyleh lerabbi yitzchak nappacha, la hava bideh. ata sheel be midresha, ufashtuha meha deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: sefer tora shechasar yeria achat – en korin bo.
Vela hi, hatam mechassar bemilleteh, hacha la mechassar bemilleteh. rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: en korin bechummashin bevet hakkeneset, mishshum kevod tzibbur.
Verabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: hay sefer aftarata – asur lemikre beh beshabbat. may tama? delo nittan likkatev.
Mar bar rav ashe amar: letaltole name asur. may tama? deha la chaze lemikre beh. vela hi, shere letaltole ushere lemikre beh –

Derabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish meayyeyni besifra deaggadta beshabbeta; veha lo nittan likkatev, ella kevan dela efshar, "et laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha"; hacha name, kevan dela efshar, "et laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha".
Bea minneh abbaye merabba: mahu lichtov megilla letinok lehitlammed bah? tibbee leman deamar: tora megilla megilla nittena; tibbee leman deamar: tora chatuma nittena.
Tibbee leman deamar tora megilla megilla nittena – kevan dimgilla megilla nittena, kotvin; o dilma, kevan deiddevak – iddevak.
Tibbee leman deamar tora chatuma nittena – kevan dachatuma nittena, en kotvin; o dilma, kevan dela efshar – katvinan? amar leh: en kotvin. uma taam? lefi sheen kotvin.
Etiveh: af hi asta tavla shel zahav, shepparashat sota ketuva aleha! amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi yannay: bealef bet.
Etiveh: keshehu kotev, roe vechotev ma shekkatuv battavla! ema: "kema shekkatuv battavla".
Etiveh: keshehu kotev, roe battavla vechotev ma shekkatuv battavla. ma hu katuv battavla? "im shachav", "im lo shachav"! hacha bemay askinan – beserugin.
Ketannae: en kotvin megilla letinok lehitlammed bah, veim dato lehashelim – muttar. rabbi yehuda omer: bivreshit – ad dor hammabbul. betorat kohanim – ad "vayhi bayyom hashshemini".

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi benaa: tora – megilla megilla nittena, shenneemar: "az amarti hinne vati bimgillat sefer katuv alay". rabbi shimon ben lakish omer: tora – chatuma nittena, shenneemar: "lakoach et sefer hattora hazzot".
Veiddach name, hachtiv "lakoach"! hahu levatar deiddevak.
Veiddach name, hachtiv "bimgillat sefer katuv alay"! hahu, dechol hattora kullah ikkeri megilla, dichtiv: "vayyomer elay ma atta roe, vaomar ani roe megilla afa".

I name, lechidrabbi levi – deamar rabbi levi: shemone parashiyyot neemru bayyom shehukam bo hammishkan, ellu hen: parashat kohanim, ufarashat leviyyim, ufarashat temeim, ufarashat shilluach temeim, ufarashat "achare mot",
b: Ufarashat shetuye yayin, ufarashat nerot, ufarashat para adumma.
Amar rabbi elazar: tora – rov bichtav umiut al pe, shenneemar: "echtov lo rubbe torati kemo zar nechshavu". verabbi yochanan amar: rov al pe umiut bichtav, shenneemar: "ki al pi haddevarim haelle".
Veiddach name, hachtiv: "echtov lo rubbe torati"! hahu, atmohe ka matma: echtov lo rubbe torati?! halo "kemo zar nechshavu"!
Veiddach name, hachtiv: "ki al pi haddevarim haelle"! hahu – mishshum detakkifi lemigmerinhu.

Daresh rabbi yehuda bar nachmani, meturegmaneh derabbi shimon ben lakish, ketiv: "ketov lecha et haddevarim haelle", uchetiv: "ki al pi haddevarim haelle" – ha ketzad? devarim shebbichtav i atta rashshay leomran al pe, devarim shebbeal pe i atta rashshay leomran bichtav, deve rabbi yishmael. tana: "elle" – elle atta kotev, vei atta kotev halachot.
Amar rabbi yochanan: lo karat hakkadosh baruch hu berit im yisrael, ella bishvil devarim shebbeal pe – shenneemar: "ki al pi haddevarim haelle karatti ittecha berit veet yisrael".

Mearvin bevayit yashan, mippene darche shalom. may tama? illema mishshum kavod, veha hahu shippura, dahava meikkara be rav yehuda, ulevassof be rabba, ulevassof be rav yosef, ulevassof be abbaye, ulevassof be rava!
Ella mishshum chashada.
Bor shehu karov laamma vechulei: ittemar: bene nahara; rav amar: tattae shatu mayya beresha, ushemuel amar: illae shatu mayya beresha.

Bidmezal – kulle alma la feligi. ki feligi – bemiskar veashkoye; shemuel amar: illae shatu mayya beresha, deamri: anan mekarvinan tefe. verav amar: tattae shatu mayya beresha, deamri: nahara kifshateh lezil.
Tenan: bor hakkarov laamma, mitmalle rishon – mippene darche shalom! targema shemuel allibba derav: beamma hammithallechet al pi voro.
I hachi, may lememra? mahu detema, matze amri leh: sechar miskar, veashki behindaza; ka mashma lan.
Amar rav huna bar tachlifa: hasheta dela ittemar hilcheta la kemar vela kemar, kol deallim gavar.

Rav shimi bar ashe ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: lotvan mar beiddana! amar leh: it li iddana ledidi. velotvan mar belelya! amar leh: it li mayya leashkoye. amar leh: ana mashkena leh lemar mayya bimama, velotvan mar belelya! amar leh: lechayye.

Azal leillae, amar lehu: tattae shatu mayya beresha. azal letattae, amar lehu: illae shatu mayya beresha. addehachi sechar miskar veashki. ki ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: keve tere avadt li! vela taminhu abbaye lefere dehahi shatta.

Hanhu bene be charmach, daazul kero beresha deshanvota, veahderu veshadyu beshilhe nahara. ato illae lekammeh deabbaye, amaru leh: ka matkel lenaharin! amar lehu: kero bahadayyhu tefe pureta. amaru leh: ka yavshi perin. amar lehu: zilu salliku nafshayychu mehatam.
Metzudot chayya veofot vedagim, yesh bahen vechulei: beuzele veohare

a: Kulle alma la peligi, ki peligi – belechi vekukere.
Metziat cheresh, shote vechulei rabbi yose omer: gazel gamur: amar rav chisda: gazel gamur middivrehem. lemay nafka minna? lehotzio bedayyaynin.
Ani hamenakkef berosh hazzayit, ma shettachtav vechulei: tana: im likket venatan bayyad – hare ze gazel gamur.

Rav kahana hava kaazel lehutzal, chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava shade ufeye veka natran tamre, azal ka menakket veachel. amar leh: chazi mar deviday shedetinhu. amar leh: meatreh derabbi yoshiyya atta. kare aleh: "vetzaddik yesod olam".

En memachin beyad aniyye goyim beleket beshichcha uvefea, mippene darche shalom: tanu rabbanan: mefarnesim aniyye goyim im aniyye yisrael, umevakkerin chole goyim im chole yisrael, vekovrin mete goyim im mete yisrael, mippene darche shalom.
Mishna mashelet ishsha lachavertah hachashuda al hashsheviit – nafa, uchevara, verechayim, vetannur. aval lo tavor velo titchan immah.

Eshet chaver mashelet leeshet am haaretz – nafa uchevara; uvoreret, vetochenet, umerakkedet immah; aval mishshettatil et hammayim – lo tigga immah, lefi sheen machzikin yede ovre avera. vechullan lo amru, ella mippene darche shalom.
Umachzikin yede goyim bashsheviit – aval lo yede yisrael; veshoalin bishloman, mippene darche shalom.
Gemara may shena resha, umay shena sefa? amar abbaye: rov amme haaretz measserin hen.

Rava amar: hacha beam haaretz derabbi meir, vetumea vetohora derabbanan – detanya: ezehu am haaretz? kol sheeno ochel chullav betohora, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: kol sheeno measser perotav.
Veha middekatane sefa: mishshettatil et hammayim lo tigga immah; mikkelal deresha, lav betumea vetohora askinan!
Resha vesefa betumea vetohora; veresha – betumeat chullin, vesefa – betumeat challa.
Ureminhu:
b: Tochanin umafkidin etzel ochle sheviit, veetzel ochle ferotehen betumea; aval lo leochle sheviit, velo leochle ferotehen betumea!
Amar abbaye: hatam, bechohen hechashud leechol teruma betumea askinan – dahava leh tumea deorayyta.
I hachi, mafkidin?! ureminhu: mafkidin teruma etzel yisrael am haaretz, velo etzel kohen am haaretz, mippene shellibbo gas bah!
Amar rabbi ila: hacha bemay askinan – bichli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil.
Velechush shemma tesitennu ishto nidda!
Ella amar rabbi yirmeya: la kashya; kan beferot shehucheshru, kan beferot shello hucheshru.
Ureminhu: hammolich chittin letachon kuti o letachon am haaretz – hare ellu bechezkatan lemaaser velishviit, aval lo letumea!
Hay may rumeya? lav okemna beferot shello hucheshru?
Udekaare la – may kaare la? mishshum deka bae lemirme achariti ala – hare ellu bechezkatan lemaaser velishviit, ulechallofe la chayyshinan.
Ureminhu: hannoten lachamoto, measser et shehu noten lah veet shehu notel hemenna, mippene shechashuda machlefet hammitkalkel!
Hatam kidkatane tama, amar rabbi yehuda: rotze hi betakkanat bittah, uvosha mechatanah.

Ulealma – la chayyshinan?! vehatnan: hannoten lappunedakit, measser et shehu noten lah veet shehu notel hemenna, mippene shemmachlefet! hatam morya veamra: bar be rav lechol chammima, vaana echol karira?!

Veakkatti, lealma la chayyshinan?! vehatanya: eshet chaver tochenet im eshet am haaretz – bizman shehi temea aval lo bizman shehi tehora. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af bizman shehi temea lo titchon, mippene shechavertah

a: Notenet lah veochelet. hasheta mignav ganva, challofe la meychallefa?!
Amar rav yosef: hatam name, morya veamra: tora middisheh kaachel.

Heid rabbi yose ben hameshullam mishshum rabbi yochanan achiv, sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben chassama: en osin challat am haaretz betohora, aval osin issat chullav betohora; venotel hemenna kede challa, umannichah bichfisha o beanchuta; ucheshebba am haaretz littol, notel et shetehen veeno choshesh.
Veen osin terumat zetav betohora, aval osin zete chullav betohora; venotel hemenna kede teruma, umannichah bechilyo shel chaver; ucheshebba am haaretz littol – notel et shetehen, veeno choshesh.
Vetama may? amar rabbi yochanan: mishshum kede chayyav degabbal, umishshum kede chayyav devaddad.
Utzericha; dei ashmoinan gabbal – mishshum dela nefish agreh, aval baddad – dinfish agreh, ema la. vei ashmoinan baddad – mishshum dela shechiach leh, aval gabbal – dishchiach leh, ema la; tzericha.

Amar mar: notel hemenna kede challa, umannichah bichfisha o beanchuta; ucheshebba am haaretz littol, notel et shetehen veeno choshesh. velechush dilma naga bah! deamrinan leh: chazi, i nagat ba hadra letivla.
Velechush dilma la ichpat leh! hasheta letakkone ka mikkavven, michpat la ichpat leh?!

Amar mar: notel hemenna kede teruma, umannichah bechilyo shel chaver; ucheshebba am haaretz littol, notel et shetehen veeno choshesh. velechush dilma naga ba! bishlama hatam, it leh hekkera; hacha, may hekkera it leh? demannach leh bichle gelalim, bichle avanim, bichle adama.
I hachi, may irya dechaver? afillu deam haaretz name! hachi name kaamar: bechelim shel am haaretz, haruyin lehishtammesh bahen chaver.

Machzikin yede goyim bashsheviit: machzikin?! vehaamar rav dimi bar shishna mishshemeh derav: en odrin im haggoy bashsheviit, veen koflin "shalom" legoy! la tzericha, lememra lehu "achzuku" bealma – ki ha derav yehuda amar lehu "achzuku"; rav sheshet amar lehu "ashsharta".
Veen koflin "shalom" legoy: rav chisda makdem veyahev lehu shelama. rav kahana amar lehu "shelama lemar".

Veshoalin bishloman. hasheta achzoke machzekinan, shoalin bishloman mibbaya?! amar rav yeva: lo nitzrecha ella leyom edam – detanya: lo yikkanes adam leveto shel goy beyom edo, veyitten lo "shalom". metzao bashshuk – noten lo besafa rafa uvechoved rosh.

Rav huna verav chisda havo yatvi. chalef veazel geniva, amar leh chad lechavreh: nekum mikkammeh, devar oryayn hu. amar lo: umikkamme palgaa nekum?! addehachi ata ihu legabbayyhu, amar lehu: shelama alayychu malche, shelama alayychu malche! amaru leh: mena lach derabbanan ikkeru melachim? amar lehu: dichtiv: "bi melachim yimlochu vegomer".
Amaru leh: umena lach dechaflinan "shelama" lemalche? amar lehu, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: minnayin shekkoflin "shalom" lemelech? shenneemar: "veruach lavsha et amasay rosh hashshalishim vegomer".

Amri leh: litom mar midde. amar lehu: hachi amar rav yehuda amar rav: asur lo leadam sheyyitom kelum ad sheyyitten maachol livhemto, shenneemar: "venatatti esev besadcha livhemtecha", vahadar: "veachalta vesavata".
Hadaran alach hannizzakin
b: Haomer "hitkabbel get ze leishti", o "holech get ze leishti", im ratza lachzor – yachzor. haishsha sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti", im ratza lachzor – lo yachzor.
Lefichach, im amar lo habbaal: "i efshi shettekabbel lah, ella holech veten lah", im ratza lachzor, yachzor.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af haomeret: "tol li gitti", im ratza lachzor – lo yachzor.
Gemara amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: tama dela shavveteh ihi shaliach likabbala, ha shavveteh ihi shaliach likabbala, ratza lachzor – lo yachzor. shema minna – "holech" kizchi" dame!
La; leolam ema lach: "holech" lav kizchi" dame, vehitkabbel get leishti" itztericha leh –
Desalka datach amena, hoil uvaal lav bar shauoye shaliach likabbala hu, af al gav dimta gitta lide – la leheve gitta; ka mashma lan, dehitkabbel veholech" kaamar.
Tenan, haishsha sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti", im ratza lachzor – lo yachzor. may, lav la shena akkabbala, la shena aholacha?
La, akkabbala.

Ta shema: lefichach, im amar lo habbaal: "i efshi shettekabbel lah, ella holech veten lah", im ratza lachzor – yachzor. tama deamar "i efshi"; ha la amar "i efshi", im ratza lachzor – lo yachzor; shema minna – "holech" kizchi" dame!
Dilma behelach".
Peshita – ish have shaliach leholacha, shekken baal molich get ishto; veishsha havya shaliach likabbala, shekken ishsha mekabbelet gittah miyyad balah. ish – lekabbala, vehaishsha – leholacha, may?

Ta shema, haomer: "hitkabbel get ze leishti", o "holech get ze leishti", im ratza lachzor – yachzor. haishsha sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti", im ratza lachzor – lo yachzor. may, lav bechad shaliach – ushema minna kasher lekabbala kasher leholacha? la, bishne sheluchin.
Ta shema: lefichach, im amar lo habbaal: "i efshi shettekabbel lah, ella holech veten lah", im ratza lachzor – yachzor. veha hacha, dechad shaliach hu, ushema minna kasher lekabbala kasher leholacha!

Peshot minna ish have shaliach lekabbala – shekken av mekabbel get levitto ketanna; ishsha leholacha – tibbee lach, may? amar rav mari, ta shema: af hannashim sheen neemanot lomar met balah, neemanot lehavi et gittah – vehatam holacha hi.
Amar rav ashe: missefa name shema minna – dekatane sefa: haishsha atzmah mevia et gittah, uvilvad shehi tzericha lomar: "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam"; veokemna beholacha; shema minna.
Ittemar: "have li gitti", veishtecha amra hitkabbel li gitti", vehu amar: "helach kema sheamra";
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: afillu higgia get leyadah – enah megoreshet. shema minna addibbura dideh ka samech – dei addibbura dida ka samech, mikki mate gitta lida miha tiggarash!
Amar rav ashe: hachi hasheta?!

a: Bishlama i ittemar ippecha: "hitkabbel li gitti", veishtecha amra have li gitti", vehu omer: "helach kema sheamra"; veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: kevan shehiggia get leyado megoreshet – alma addibbura dida hu deka samech;
I name "leyadah" – addibbura dideh ka samech. ella hacha – mishshum deakray shaliach lishlichuteh ligmare hu; deamar: shaliach likabbala havena, leholacha la havena.
Amar rav huna bar chiyyay: ta shema, haomer: "hitkabbel get ze leishti" o "holech get ze leishti", ratza lachzor – yachzor. tama deratza, ha lo ratza – have get;

Veammay? ha baal lav bar shauoye shaliach likabbala hu! ella amrinan: kevan shennatan enav legarshah, memar amar: tiggarash kol hechi demiggarsha; hacha name, kevan shennatan enav legarshah, memar amar: tiggarash kol hechi demiggarsha!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam – adam yodea sheen shelichut lekabbala, vegamar venatan leshem holacha; hacha – tae.

Amar rava: ta shema, ketanna sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti" – eno get ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. ki mate gitta lida – miha miggarsha, veammay? veha lav shaliach leholacha shavveyeh! ella amrinan: kevan shennatan enav legarshah, memar amar: tiggarash kol hechi demiggarsha; hacha name, kevan shennatan enav legarshah, memar amar: tiggarash kol hechi demiggarsha!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam – adam yodea sheen shelichut lekatan, vegamar venatan lah leshum holacha dideh; hacha – tae.

Ta shema: "have li gitti", veishtecha amra hitkabbel li gitti"; "hitkabbel li gitti", veishtecha amra have li gitti", vehu omer: "holech veten lah", "zeche lah", vehitkabbel lah" – ratza lachzor, yachzor; mishshehiggia get leyadah – megoreshet.
May, lav kabbala – akkabbala, veholacha – aholacha?
La; kabbala – aholacha, veholacha – akkabbala.
I kabbala aholacha – mikki mate gitta lideh, lealtar leheve gitta! shamat minna, deaddibbura dideh ka samech!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam kaamar leh: "helach kema sheamra", hacha mi kaamar leh: "helach kema sheamra"?!

Tanu rabbanan: "hitkabbel li gitti", veishtecha amra hitkabbel li gitti", vehu omer: "holech", veten lah", "zeche lah", vehitkabbel lah" – ratza lachzor, lo yachzor. rabbi natan omer: "holech veten lah" – ratza lachzor, yachzor; "zeche lah" vehitkabbel lah" – ratza lachzor, lo yachzor.
Rabbi omer: bechullan – im ratza lachzor, lo yachzor. aval im amar lo: "i efshi shettekabbel lah, ella holech veten lah", ratza lachzor – yachzor.
Rabbi hayeynu tanna kamma! ibbaet ema: "i efshi" ata leashmoinan; veibbaet ema: ha ka mashma lan, man tanna kamma – rabbi.
Ibbaya lehu: "helach" – lerabbi natan, kizche" dame, o lav kizche" dame?
Ta shema: haomer "hitkabbel get ze leishti" o "holech get ze leishti", ratza lachzor – yachzor. haishsha sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti", ratza lachzor – lo yachzor.
b: May, lav behelach" – verabbi natan? la; beholech" – verabbi.
Ta shema: lefichach, im amar lo habbaal: "i efshi shettekabbel lah, ella holech veten lah", ratza lachzor – yachzor. tama deamar: "i efshi"; ha la amar: "i efshi", ratza lachzor – lo yachzor;
May, lav behelach" – verabbi natan? la; beholech" – verabbi.

Ta shema: "holech get ze leishti" – ratza lachzor, yachzor. "helach get ze leishti" – ratza lachzor, lo yachzor. man shamat leh deamar beholech" – ratza lachzor, yachzor – rabbi natan; vekaamar behelach" – ratza lachzor, lo yachzor; shema minna – "helach" kizche" dame; shema minna.
Ittemar: "hitkabbel li gitti", veishtecha amra hitkabbel li gitti", vehu omer: "holech veten lah" – amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: naasa shelucho usheluchah – vecholetzet.
Lememra dimsappeka leh lerav i "holech" kizche" dame, i lav kizche" dame?! veha ittemar: "holech mane lifloni sheani chayyayv lo", amar rav: chayyayv beachrayuto, veim ba lachzor – eno chozer!
Hatam – sefek mamona lekulla, hacha – sefek issura lechumera.
Amar rav: en haishsha osa shaliach lekabbel lah gittah miyyad sheliach balah. verabbi chanina amar: ishsha osa shaliach lekabbel lah gittah miyyad sheliach balah.
May tama derav? ibbaet ema: mishshum bizzayon devaal;
Ibbaet ema: mishshum chatzerah habba leachar mikkan.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu dikdama ihi, veshavviyya shaliach meikkara.
Hahu gavra deshaddar la gitta lidvethu, azal shelicha ashkecha ki yatva veka laysha, amar la: "helach gittach", amara leh: "leheve bidach". amar rav nachman: im ita lidrabbi chanina, avadi ba ovada.
Amar leh rava: veim ita lidrabbi chanina, avadt ba ovada?! ha lo chazra shelichut etzel habbaal!
Shalchuha lekammeh derabbi amme, shelach lehu: lo chazra shelichut etzel habbaal. verabbi chiyyay bar abba amar: nityayshshev baddavar.
Hadur shalchuha kammeh derabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar: kol hane shalchu la veazli? ki hechi dimsappeka lehu ledidhu, hachi name mesappeka lan ledidan;
Have davar shebbaerva, vedavar shebbaerva – choletzet.
Hava ovada, veatzrecha rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta get vachalitza. tarte?! get mechayyim, vachalitza leachar mita.
Hahi dahavo karu la "nafata", azul sahade ketuv "tafata". amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav: asu edim shelichutan.
Matkef la rabba: mi kaamar lehu "ketuvu chaspa vehavu la"?! ella amar rabba: vadday, i ketuv sahade gitta mealleya, vaavad, asu edim shelichutan.
Matkef la rav nachman: mi kaamar lehu "ketuvu veannechu bechisayychu"?! ella amar rav nachman: kotvin venotnin, afillu mea peamim.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: "kitvu, utenu leshaliach", mahu? salloke sallek lehu, o dilma letircha didhu chayesh?
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: "veyolich lah", mahu? teku.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af haomeret "tol li gitti", im ratza lachzor – lo yachzor. tanu rabbanan: "tol li", vesa li", vihe li beyadecha" – kullan leshon kabbala hen.
Mishna haishsha sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti", tzericha shete kitte edim – shenayim sheomrim: "befanenu amra", ushenayim sheomrim: "befanenu kibbel, vekara"; afillu hen harishonim vehen haacharonim,

a: O echad min harishonim, veechad min haacharonim, veechad mitztaref immahen.
Gemara ittemar: baal omer lefikkadon, veshalish omer legerushin – mi neeman? rav huna amar: baal neeman, verav chisda amar: shalish neeman.
Rav huna amar: baal neeman – deim ita dilgerushin yahaveh nihaleh, ledida hava yahev la nihala. verav chisda amar: shalish neeman – deha hemneh.
Metiv rabbi abba: hodaat baal din kemea edim dame, veshalish neeman mishshenehem. ketzad? ze omer kach, veze omer kach, shalish neeman!
Shane mamon, deityehiv limchilla.
Veha tanya: vechen legittin! gitte mamon. vehatanya: vechen lishtarot!
Midde gabbe hadade tanya?!
Tenan, haishsha sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti", tzericha shete kitte edim – shenayim sheyyomru: "befanenu amra", ushenayim sheyyomru: "befanenu kibbel, vekara". veammay? lihemneh leshalish!
Mi ka nafek gitta mittute yedeh – delihemneh?!
Tinach amra; kibbel lema li? amar rabba: ha manni – rabbi elazar hi, deamar: ede mesira karti.
Kara lema li? amar rav yehuda amar rav: bishat hashshemad shanu.
Amar rabba: umode rav huna, dei amara ihi: ledidi amar li shalish dilgerushin yahaveh nihaleh – mehemna. mi ikka midde deshalish gufeh la meheman, veihi mehemna?!
Ella i amara: kammay didi legerushin yahaveh nihaleh – mehemna; miggo dei baaya amra ledida yahaveh nihala baal.
Baal omer legerushin, veshalish omer legerushin, vehi omeret: natan li, veavad – amar rabbi yochanan: have davar shebbaerva, veen davar shebbeerva pachot mishshenayim.
Veammay? velihemneh leshalish! mi ka nafek gitta mittute yedeh delihemneh?!
Velihemneh levaal – deamar rav chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yochanan: baal sheamar "gerashti et ishti" – neeman! mi kaamar "gerashti"?!

Velema: chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto – deamar rabbi yitzchak, haomer lishlucho: "tze vekaddesh li ishsha" – setam, umet shelucho – asur bechol hannashim shebbaolam; chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto!
b: Hane mille lechumera, aval lekulla la.
Velihemna ledida, midderav hamenuna – deamar rav hamenuna, haishsha sheamra levalah: "gerashtani" – neemenet, chazaka en haishsha meizza paneha bifne balah!
Hane mille hecha delekka deka mesayyay la, aval hecha dimsayyay la – meizza umeizza.

Mishna naara hameorasa, hi veaviha mekabbelin et gittah. amar rabbi yehuda: en shete yadayim zochot keachat, ella aviha mekabbel et gittah bilvad. vechol sheenah yechola lishmor et gittah, enah yechola lehitgaresh.
Gemara bemay kamippalgi? rabbanan savri: yeda yattirta zakki la rachamana, verabbi yehuda savar: bimkom aviha – yad dila lav kelum hi.

Vechol sheenah yechola lishmor et gittah. tanu rabbanan: ketanna hayyodaat lishmor et gittah – mitgareshet, vesheenah yodaat lishmor et gittah – enah mitgareshet. veezo hi ketanna yodaat lishmor et gittah? kol shemmeshammeret gittah vedavar acher.
May kaamar? amar rabbi yochanan, hachi kaamar: kol shemmeshammeret davar acher mechamat gittah.
Matkef la rav huna bar manoach: ha shota bealma hi! ella amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika: kol shemmavchenet ben gittah ledavar acher.
Amar rav yehuda amar rabbi assi: tzeror vezorko, egoz venotlo – zoche leatzmo, veen zoche laacherim. chefetz – umachziro leachar shaa, zoche ben leatzmo uven laacherim.
Ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: da veda achat hi. may "da veda achat hi"? amar rav chisda: echad ze veechad ze – zoche leatzmo, veen zoche laacherim.

Metiv rav chinnana vavrdan: ketzad mishtattefin bemavoy? manniach et hechavit, veomer: "hare zo lechol bene hammavoy", umezakke lahem al yede beno uvitto haggedolim, veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim.
Hay shifcha – hechi dame? i deatya shete searot, may baaya gabbeh? ella lav dela atya shete searot, vekatane zocha laacherim?
Shane shittufe mevoot – derabbanan.
Amar rav chisda: ishtik vavrdan. may hava leh lememar? kol detakkun rabbanan –

a: Keen deorayyta takkun.
Veiddach – ki amrinan: kol detakkun rabbanan keen deorayyta takkun – bemilleta deit la ikkar min hattora, aval milleta delet la ikkar min hattora – la.
Metiv rav avya: maarimin al maaser sheni. ketzad? omer adam livno uvitto haggedolim; leavdo veshifchato haivrim: "he lachem maot hallalu, ufedu bahen maaser sheni ze", veochlo belo chomesh.
Hay shifcha hechi dame? i deatya shete searot, may baaya gabbeh? ella lav dela atya shete searot? hacha bemay askinan, bemaaser bizman hazze – derabbanan.
Veama haivriyya bizman hazze mi ikka?! vehatanya: en eved ivri noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg! ella beatzitz sheeno nakuv – derabbanan.
Amar rava, shalosh middot bekatan: tzeror vezorko, egoz venotlo – zoche leatzmo, veen zoche laacherim; uchenegdan biktanna – mitkaddeshet lemeun.
Happaotot – mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar bemittaltelin; uchenegdan biktanna – mitgareshet bekiddushe aviha.
Higgiu leonat nedarim – nidrehen neder vehekdeshan hekdesh; uchenegdan biktanna – choletzet. velimkor benichse aviv – ad sheyyehe ben esrim.
Mishna ketanna sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti" – eno get ad sheyyaggia get leyadah; lefichach, im ratza habbaal lachazor – yachzor. sheen katan ose shaliach.
Veim amar lo aviha: "tze vehitkabbel levitti gittah", im ratza lachazor – lo yachzor.
Haomer: "ten get ze leishti bemakom peloni", unetano lah bemakom acher – pasul. "hare hi bemakom peloni", unetano lah bemakom acher – kasher.
Haishsha sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti bemakom peloni", vekibbelo lah bemakom acher – pasul; rabbi elazar machshir. "have li gitti mimmakom peloni", vehevio lah mimmakom acher – kasher.
Gemara verabbi elazar – may shena resha dela pelig, umay shena sefa diflig?
Ihu, demiddateh megaresh – kafed, ihi, dival kurcha mitgareshet – mara makom hi lo.

Mishna "have li gitti" – ochelet bitruma ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. "hitkabbel li gitti", asura leechol bitruma miyyad. "hitkabbel li gitti bemakom peloni" – ochelet bitruma ad sheyyaggia get leoto makom, rabbi elazar oser miyyad.
Gemara vegitta miha have? vehaamrat resha, la have gitta!
La tzericha, deamra leh: "hitkabbel li gitta bemata machseya, vezimnin demashkachat leh bevavel"; vehachi kaamra leh: mishkal – kol hecha demashkachat leh, shikleh minneh;
b: Gitta la have – ad dematet lemata machseya.
Verabbi elazar oser miyyad. peshita, deha mara makom hi lo!
La tzericha, daamara leh: "zil lemizrach, deiteh bemizrach"; veka azel lemaarav. mahu detema, bemaarav – ha leteh; ka mashma lan, dilma bahade dekaazel megas gaes beh, vihav leh gitta.
Haomer lishlucho "arev li bitmarim", veerav lo bigrogrot; "bigrogrot", veerav lo bitmarim; tane chada: eruvo eruv, vetanya iddach: en eruvo eruv!
Amar rabba: la kashya; ha rabbanan, ha rabbi elazar. ha rabbanan – deamri: kefida; ha rabbi elazar, deamar: mara makom hi lo.
Verav yosef amar: ha veha rabbanan; kan beshello, kan beshel chavero.

Amar leh abbaye: veella ha detanya, haomer lishlucho: "arev li bemigdal" – veerav lo beshovach, "beshovach" – veerav lo bemigdal; detanya chada: eruvo eruv, vetanya iddach: en eruvo eruv; hatam – may shello veshel chavero ikka?
Hatam name, ikka pere demigdal ufere deshovach.
Mishna haomer: "kitvu get utenu leishti"; "garshuha"; "kitvu iggeret utenu la" – hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu.
"Patteruha"; "parnesuha"; "asu lah kenimus"; "asu lah karauy" – lo amar kelum.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "shallechuha"; "shivkuha"; "tarchuha" – hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. "patteruha"; "parnesuha"; "asu lah kenimos"; "asu lah karauy" – lo amar kelum.

Tanya, rabbi natan omer: "patteruha" – devarav kayyaymin, "pitruha" – lo amar kelum. amar rava: rabbi natan – devavlaa hu, vedayek ben "pitruha" lefatteruha", tanna didan – devar eretz yisrael hu, la dayek.
Ibbaya lehu: "hotziuha", mahu? "izvuha", mahu? "hattiruha", mahu? "hannichuha", mahu? "hoilu lah", mahu? "asu lah kaddat", mahu?
Peshot miha chada, detanya: "asu lah kaddat"; "asu lah kenimos"; "asu lah karauy" – lo amar kelum.
Mishna barishona hayu omrim: hayyotze bekolar, veamar: "kitvu get leishti" – hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. chazru lomar: af hamefaresh, vehayyotze bishyayra. rabbi shimon shezuri omer: af hamesukkan.
Gemara geniva yotze bekolar hava, ki hava ka nafek, amar: havu arba mea zuze lerabbi avina, mechamra dinhar panya. amar rabbi zera:

a: Dera rabbi avina lesilleteh, vaazal legabbe derav huna rabbeh – deamar rav huna: gitto kemattenato, ma mattenato, im amad – chozer, af gitto, im amad – chozer.
Uma gitto, af al gav dela paresh, kevan deamar "kitvu" – af al gav dela amar "tenu"; af mattenato, kevan deamar "tenu" – af al gav dela keno minneh.
Matkef la rabbi abba: i – ma mattana yeshnah leachar mita, af get yeshno leachar mita?! hachi hasheta?! bishlama mattana – ita leachar mita, ella get – leachar mita mi ikka?!

Ella rabbi abba, hachi ka kashya leh: mattenat shechiv mera bemiktzat hi, umattenat shechiv mera bemiktzat baaya kinyan! mikkelal derav huna savar la baaya kinyan?! veha kayyma lan devaaya kinyan! shane hacha demtzavve mechamat mita hu.
Mikkelal derabbi abba savar: metzavve mechamat mita baaya kinyan?! veha kayyma lan dela bae kinyan!

Ella rabbi abba, hachi ka kashya leh: "chamra" – la kaamar, "deme chamra" – la kaamar, "mechamra" kaamar! veiddach, "mechamra" – kede leyaypot et kocho. shelachu mittam: "mechamra" – kede leyaypot et kocho.
Mishna mi shehaya mushelach levor, veamar: kol hashshomea et kolo yichtov get leishto, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu.
Gemara velechush shemma shed hu! amar rav yehuda: kesherau lo demut adam.

Inhu name iddemoye iddemo! dachazo leh bavua. inhu name it lehu bavua! dachazo leh bavua devavua. vedilma inhu name it lehu? amar rabbi chanina: limmedani yonatan beni: bavua it lehu, bavua devavua let lehu.
Vedilma tzara hi! tana deve rabbi yishmael: bishat hassakkana, kotvin venotnin af al pi sheen makkirin.
Mishna habbari sheamar: "kitvu get leishti" – ratza lesachek bah.
Maase bevari echad sheamar: "kitvu get leishti", veala lerosh haggag venafal vamet; amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: im meatzmo nafal, hare ze get, im haruach dachattu – eno get.
Gemara maase listor?!

Chassore michassera, vehachi katane: im hochiach sofo al techillato – hare ze get; umaase name bevari sheamar: "kitvu get leishti", veala lerosh haggag venafal vamet, veamar rabban shimon ben gamliel: im meatzmo nafal – hare ze get, im haruach dachattu – eno get.

Hahu gavra deal leve chenishta, ashkach makre yanoka uvereh deyatvi, veyatev inish acharina gabbayyhu, amar lehu: be tere minnayychu nichtevu gitta lidvethu. lesof shechev makre yanoka, mi meshauu inashe bera shelicha bimkom abba, o la?
Rav nachman amar: la meshauu inashe bera shelicha bimkom abba; verav pappe amar: meshauu inashe bera shelicha bimkom abba. amar rava, hilcheta: meshauu inashe bera shelicha bimkom abba.
Mishna amar lishnayim: "tenu get leishti",
b: O lishlosha: "kitvu get, utenu leishti", hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. amar lishlosha: "tenu get leishti", hare ellu yomru laacherim veyichtevu, mippene sheasaan bet din; divre rabbi meir.
Vezo halacha heela rabbi chanina ish ono mibbet haasurin: mekubbal ani beomer lishlosha: "tenu get leishti" – sheyyomru laacherim veyichtevu, mippene sheasaan bet din,
Amar rabbi yose, numenu lashshaliach: af anu mekubbalin, sheafillu amar levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim: "tenu get leishti" – sheyyilmedu veyichtevu veyittenu.
Amar laasara: "kitvu utenu get leishti" – echad kotev, ushenayim chotmin. "kullechem ketovu" – echad kotev, vechullam chotmin; lefichach im met echad mehen – hare ze get batel.

Gemara amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: shelachu leh mibbe rav lishmuel: yelammedenu rabbenu; amar lishnayim: "kitvu utenu get leishti", veamru lesofer vechatav, vechatmu hen, mahu? shelach lehu: tetze, vehaddavar tzarich talmud.
May "haddavar tzarich talmud"? illema mishshum dehavu lehu mille; umesappeka leh mille – i mimmasran leshaliach, i la mimmasran leshaliach;
Vehaamar shemuel amar rabbi: halacha kerabbi yose, deamar mille la mimmasran leshaliach!
Ella lishmuel – ha ka mibbaya leh: hay "ketovu" – i ketav yadan, i ketav hagget?
