Vetifshot leh mimmatnitin: amar lishnayim: "tenu get leishti", o lishlosha: "kitvu get utenu leishti" – hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu.

Hi gufa ka mibbaya leh, "ketovu" – ketav yadan hu, o ketav hagget hu? peshita dichtav hagget hu, dekatane sefa: amar rabbi yose, numenu lashshaliach: af anu mekubbalin, sheafillu amar levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim: "tenu get leishti" – sheyyilmedu veyichtevu veyittenu lah.
I amrat bishlama ketav hagget hu, shappir; ella i amrat ketav yadan hu, mi ikka be dina dela yadi michtam chatimat yedayyhu?! in, ikka be dina chadta.
Vei sevira lan dehay "ketovu" – ketav yadan hu; ha ketav hagget – kasher?! vehaamar shemuel, amar rabbi: halacha kerabbi yose, deamar mille la mimmasran leshaliach!

Amri: i seviri lan dichtovu" – ketav yadan hu; ketav hagget – naasa keomer: "imru", umode rabbi yose beomer "imru". umi mode rabbi yose beomer: "imru"?! vehatnan: "katav sofer veed – kasher", veamar rabbi yirmeya: "chatam sofer" shaninu;
Veamar rav chisda: matnitin manni – rabbi yose hi, deamar: mille la mimmasran leshaliach.
Vei salka datach mode rabbi yose beomer "imru", nafek minna chureba – dezimnin deamar lehu lishnayim:

a: "Imru lesofer veyichtov, velifloni ufeloni veyachtomu"; umishshum kissufa desofer – chayyshi umachtemi chad mehanach sahadi, vesofer bahadayyhu, uvaal la amar hachi!
Kevan deamar mar: "kasher, velo tease ken beyisrael" – la shechiach.

Velechush dilma amar lehu leve tere: "imru lesofer veyichtov, veattem chatomu", veazli hanach mishshum kissufa desofer, umachtemi leh lesofer bahade chad minnayyhu, uvaal la amar hachi! amri: ha name "kasher velo tease" hu.
Hanicha leman deamar: "kasher velo tease"; ella leman deamar "kasher vetaase" – may ikka lememar?
Ella rabbi yose – tarte amar; ushemuel savar la kevoteh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.

Gufa – amar shemuel amar rabbi: halacha kerabbi yose, deamar mille la mimmasran leshaliach. amar lefanav rabbi shimon berabbi: meachar sherabbi meir vachanina ish ono cholkin al rabbi yose, ma raa rabbi lomar halacha kerabbi yose?
Amar lo: shetok beni, shetok, lo raita et rabbi yose, ilmale reito – nimmuko immo.

Detanya, isi ben yehuda haya mone shivchan shel chachamim: rabbi meir – chacham vesofer; rabbi yehuda – chacham lichsheyyirtze; rabbi tarfon – gal shel egozin; rabbi yishmael – chanut meyuzzenet; rabbi akiva – otzar balum; rabbi yochanan ben nuri – kuppat harochlim; rabbi elazar ben azarya – kuppa shel besamim; mishnat rabbi eliezer ben yaakov – kav venaki; rabbi yose – nimmuko immo; rabbi shimon – tochen harebe umotzi kima.
Tana: meshakkeach kima, uma shemmotzi – eno motzi ella subbin. vechen amar rabbi shimon letalmidav: banayy, shenu middotay, shemmiddotay terumot mitterumot middotav shel rabbi akiva.
Gufa – amar lishnayim: "imru lesofer veyichtov, velifloni ufeloni veyachtomu" – amar rav huna amar rav: kasher, velo tease zot beyisrael.
Amar leh ulla lerav nachman, veamri la rav nachman leulla: meachar dechasher, ammay lo tease zot beyisrael? amar leh: chayyshinan shemma tiskor edim.
Umi chayyshinan?! vehatanya: edim hachatumin al sede mikkach, veal get ishsha – lo chashu chachamim ledavar ze! maase la avdi, dibbura kaamri.
Amar lishnayim: "imru lesofer veyichtov, veattem chatomu" – rav chisda amar: "kasher velo tease", rabba bar bar chana amar: "kasher vetease";
Rav nachman amar: "kasher velo tease", rav sheshet amar: "kasher vetease"; rabba amar: "kasher velo tease", rav yosef amar: "kasher vetease".
b: Veikka deafech lehu.

Amar laasara: "kitvu get". tanu rabbanan, amar laasara: "kitvu get, utenu leishti" – echad kotev al yede kullam. "kullechem ketovu" – echad kotev bemaamad kullam. "holichu get leishti" – echad molich al yede kullam. "kullechem holichu" – echad molich bemaamad kullam.
Ibbaya lehu: mana otan, mahu? rav huna amar: mana eno kechullechem", rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi elazar demin roma amar: mana hare hu kechullechem".
Amar rav pappa: vela peligi; ha demana kullehu, veha demana miktzatayyhu – amri la lehay gisa, veamri la lehay gisa.
Atken rav yehuda begitta dechullechem": ketovu – o kullechon o kol chad vechad minnechon; chatomu – o kullechon o kol tere minnechon; ovilu – o kullechon o kol chad vechad minnechon.
Amar rava: zimnin degaez leh ledibbureh, veamar "kullechon" vela amar "kol chad minnechon", veate leippesole!
Ella amar rava: "ketovu – kol chad minnechon, chatomu – kol tere minnechon, ovilu – kol chad minnechon".
Hadaran alach haomer
Mi sheachazo kuredyaykos, veamar: "kitvu get leishti" – lo amar kelum. amar: "kitvu get leishti", vaachazo kuredyaykos, vechazar veamar: "lo tichtevennu" – en devarav haacharonim kelum.
Nishtattek, veamru lo: "nichtov get leishtecha", vehirkin berosho – bodkin oto shelosha peamim, im amar al lav – "lav", veal hen – "hen", hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu.
Gemara may kuredyaykos? amar shemuel: denachteh chamra chadta dematzarta. velitne: mi shenneshacho yayin chadash! ha ka mashma lan, deha rucha – "kuredyaykos" shema.
Lemay nafka minna? likmia. may asuteh? bisra summaka aggumere, vechamra marka.

Amar abbaye, amara li em: leshimsha bat yoma – kuza demayya. bat tere yome – sikkure. bat telata yome – bisra summaka aggumere, vechamra marka. leshimsha attikta – layte tarnegolta ukkamti, velikrea sheti vaerev, veligallecheh limtziata deresheh – velotveh illaveh, venannecheh illaveh ad (demisserach);

Velinchot velekum bemayya ad tzavvereh – ad dechalesh alma illaveh, velemod, velislayk velitev. vei la – lechol karate, velinchot velekum bemayya ad tzavvereh – ad dechalesh alma illaveh, velemod, velislayk velitev.
Leshimsha – bisra summaka aggumere, vechamra marka. letalga – bisra shammina aggumere, vechamra chayyay.

Rav amram chasida, ki hava metzaarin leh be resh galuta, havo magnu leh attalga. limchar amaru leh: may nicha leh lemar delayyto leh? amar: hane, kol deamena lehu – mefach afchi. amar lehu: bisra summaka aggumere, vechamra marka. ayyto leh inhu: bisra shammina aggumere, vechamra chayyay.
Shama yalta, umeayyeyla leh leve massuta, umokmi leh bemayya deve massuta – ad dimhafchi mayya deve massuta vehavu dema, vekae bisreh peshite peshite.
Rav yosef iasek berichya. rav sheshet iasek bichshure, amar: gedola melacha shemmechammemet et bealeha.

Amar leh resh galuta lerav sheshet: may tama la saed mar gabban? amar leh: dela meallu avde, dachashidi aever min hachay. amar leh: mi yemar? amar leh: hasheta machvena lach. amar leh leshammaeh: zil genov, ayyti li chada kara mechevta.

Ayyti leh. amar lehu: ahdemu li hademe dechevta. ayyto telat kare, otivu kammeh. amar lehu: ha baalat shalosh raglayim havay? pesuk ayyto chada mealma, otivu kammeh. amar leh leshammaeh: otvay name lehach didach. otva. amar lehu: hay bat chamesh raglayim havay?!

Amar leh: i hachi, libedu kammeh (shammaeh) demar, velechol. amar leh: lechayye. karivu takka kammayyhu, veayyto kammeh bisra, veotivu kammeh ristana dechanka chamta. gashshesheh veshakla, karcha besudareh.
Levatar deachel, amri leh:

a: Iggeniv lan kasa dechaspa! bahade deka meayyeyni veatu, ashkechuha dichrivcha besudareh.

Amri leh: chazi mar, dela mechal ka bae – ella letzaoran! amar lehu: ana mechol achali, uteami beh tama dechivvara. amri leh: chivvara la avid lan haiddana. amar lehu: bedaku beducheteh; deamar rav chisda: ukkama bechivvara, vechivvara beukkamta – lakuta hi. beduk ashkechu.

Ki ka nafek, kero leh bera ushedo leh tzippeta illaveh, veamri leh: lete mar lenach. nechar leh rav chisda meachoreh. amar leh leyanoka: pesok li pesukaych, amar leh: "nete lecha al yemincha o al semolecha". amar le leshammaeh: may ka chazet? amar leh: tzippeyta deshadya. amar leh: hadar minna.
Levatar dinfak, amar leh rav chisda: mena hava yada mar? amar leh: chada – dinchar li mar. veod – difsak li yanoka pesuka. veod – dachashidi avde dela meallu.

"Asiti li sharim vesharot vetaanugot bene haadam, shidda veshiddot"; "sharim vesharot" – ellu mine zemer, "vetaanugot bene haadam" – ellu berechot umerchatzaot, "shidda veshiddot" – hacha targimu: sheda veshedtin. bemareva amri: shiddeta.
Amar rabbi yochanan: shelosh meot mine shedim hayu beshichin, vesheda atzmah eni yodea ma hi.

Amar mar, hacha targimu: sheda veshedtin. sheda veshedtin – lemay ibbei leh? dichtiv: "vehabbayit behibbanoto even shelema massa nivna vegomer" – amar lehu lerabbanan: hechi eeved? amaru leh: ikka shamira deayyti moshe leavne efod.

Amar lehu: hecha ishtechach? amaru leh: ayyti sheda veshedtin kavshinhu ahadade, efshar deyadi umegallu lach. ayyti sheda veshedtin kavshinhu ahadade, amri: anan la yadinan, dilma ashmeday – malka deshede, yada.

Amar lehu: hecha iteh? amri leh: iteh betura pelan. karya leh bera, umalya leh mayya, umikkasseya betinnara, vachatima begushepankeh; vechol yoma salek lirkia vegamar metivta dirkia, venachet leara vegamar metivta deara; veate sayer leh legushepankeh umegalle leh veshate, umechasse leh vechatem leh veazel.

Shaddereh livnayahu ben yehoyada, yehav leh shushilta dachakik ala shem, veizketa dachakik ala shem, ugevave deamra, vezike dechamra. azal, kera bera mittattay, ushefinhu lemayya, vesatminhu bigvave deamra; uchera bera meillay, (veshafchinhu) [veshafcheh] lechamra; vetamminhu. selek yetev beilana

Ki ata sayyreh legushepanka, galleyeh, ashkecheh chamra. amar: ketiv: "letz hayyayin home shechar, vechol shoge bo lo yechkam", uchetiv: "zenut veyayin vetirosh yikkach lev". la ishti. ki tzache, la saggi leh; ishti, reva ugena.
Nechet, ata, sheda beh shushilta, setameh. ki ittear, hava ka mipparzal; amar leh: shema demarach alach! shema demarach alach!
Ki naket leh veate, meta dikla – chaf beh, shadyeh; meta leveta – shadyeh; meta gabbe kubba dehahi armalta, nefaka
b: Ichannana leh. kefa lekomteh minneh, ittevar beh garma. amar, hayeynu dichtiv: "velashon rakka tishbor garem".

Chaza samya dahava ka tae beorcha, assekeh leorcheh. chaza ravya dahava ka tae beorcha, assekeh leorcheh. chaza chedvevta dahavo kamchaddi la, becha. shameh lehahu gavra dahava kaamar leushekafa: aved li mesane leshav shene, achech. chaza hahu kassama dahava kasem, achech.

Ki meta lehatam, la ayyeylu legabbeh dishlomo ad telata yome. yoma kamma amar lehu: ammay la ka vae li malka legabbeh? amaru leh: anseh mishteya. shekal leventa otev achavirta. ato amaru leh lishlomo. amar lehu, hachi amar lechu: hadur ashkeyu.
Limchar amar lehu: veammay la ka bae li malka legabbeh? amaru leh: anseh mechla. shekal leventa mechavirta, otva aara. ato amaru leh lishlomo. amar lehu, hachi amar lechu: negidu minneh mechleh.

Lesof telata yome ayayl lekammeh. shekal kanya, umeshach arbea garmide, usheda kammeh. amar leh: mikkedi ki mayet hahu gavra, let leh behaden alma ella arbaa garmide; hasheta kevashteh lechulle alma, vela sevat ad dichvasht name ledidi?!

Amar leh: la ka vaena minnach midde; baena deevneyeh levet hammikdash, veka mibbee li shamira. amar leh: ledidi la mesir li, lesara deyamma maser leh; vela yahev leh ella letarnegola bara, dimheman leh ashshevuateh.

Umay aved beh? mamte leh leture delet behu yishshuv, umannach le ashshinna detura, ufaka tura; umenakket mayyti bizrane meilane, veshade hatam, vehave yishshuv. vehayeynu dimtargeminan: "naggar tura".

Bedaku kinna detarnegola bara deit leh bene, vechappeyu lekinneh zuggita chivvarti. ki ata, bae lemeal vela matze. azal ayyti shamira, veotveh illaveh. rema beh kala, shadyeh, shakleh. azal chanak nafsheh ashshevuateh.
Amar leh benayahu: may tama ki chaziteh lehahu samya dahava ka tae beorcha, assekteh leorcheh? amar leh: machrezi aleh birkia detzaddik gamur hu, uman daavad leh nicha nafsheh, zache lealma deate.
Umay tama ki chazeteh lehahu ravya dekatae beorcha, assekteh leorcheh? amar leh: machrezi aleh birkia derasha gamur hu, veavdi leh nicha nafsheh ki hechi delechleh lealma.
May tama ki chazeteh lehahu chedvevta, bechet? amar leh: bae memat gavra bego telatin yomin, uvaaya mintar leyavam katan telesre shenin.
May tama ki shemateh lehahu gavra daamar leh leushekafa: "aved li mesane leshav shenin", achecht? amar leh: hahu, shiva yome let leh, mesane leshav shenin bae?!
May tama ki chazeteh lehahu kassama dahava kasem, achecht? amar leh: dahava yetev abbe gazza demalka, liksom may deikka tuteh!

Tarcheh gabbeh ad devanyeh levet hammikdash. yoma chad hava kae lechodeh, amar leh: ketiv: "ketoafot reem lo"; veamrinan: "ketoafot" – ellu malache hashsharet, "reem" – ellu hashshedim. may revutayychu minnan?

Amar leh: shekol shushilta minnay, vehav li izketach, veachvi lach revutay. shakleh leshushilta minneh, veyahev leh izketeh. baleh, otveh lechad gappeh birkia, ulechad gappeh beara, patkeh arba mea parse. al hahi shata amar shelomo: "ma yitron laadam bechol amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh".

"Veze haya chelki mikkol amali" – may "veze"? rav ushemuel; chad amar: maklo; vechad amar: gunedo. haya mechazzer al happetachim, kol hecha dimta, amar: "ani kohelet hayiti melech al yisrael birushalaym". ki meta gabbe sanhedrin, amaru rabbanan: mikkedi shote – bachada milleta la serich, may hay?

Amaru leh livnayahu: ka vae lach malka legabbeh? amar lehu: la. shelachu lehu lemalkevota: kaate malka legabbayychu? shelachu lehu: in, kaate. shelachu lehu: bidku bechareh. shelachu lehu: bemuke kaate;
Veka tava lehu beniddutayyhu; veka tava la name levat sheva immeh. atyu lishlomo, vehavu leh izketa, veshushilta dachakivk aleha shem. ki ayel, chazyeh, perach.

Vaafillu hachi, hava leh biatuta minneh. vehayeynu dichtiv: "hinne mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah miggibbore yisrael, kullam achuze cherev melummede milchama, ish charbo al yerecho mippachad ballelot".
Rav ushemuel, chad amar: melech vehedyot, vechad amar: melech vehedyot umelech.

Lidma deresha – layte shurebina, uvina, veasa dara, vezeta, vechilfa, vechilfe deyamma, veyavla; velishlokinhu bahade hadade; velintol telat mea kase ahay gisa deresha, utelat mea kase ahay gisa deresha.
Vei la – layte varda chivvara dekae bechad dara, velishlekeh, velintol shittin kase ahay gisa deresha, veshittin kase ahay gisa deresha.

Litzlichta – layte tarnegola bara; velishchateh bezuza chivvara – ahahu gisa dechayev leh, venizdehar middemeh dela lesamminhu leeneh; velitleyeh besefa devava – dechi ayel chayef beh, vechi nafek chayef beh.

a: Livruketi – layte akrabba deshav chumere, uneyaybsheh betulla; venishchok tarte menata kuchela, vachada menata minneh; velimle talta machchale behay ena utelata machchale behay ena; tefe la limalle, dei la – paka eneh.

Leshavrire delelya – nete shudera barka, venesar chada kara minneh vachada kara mikkalba; venitrefu yanoke chaspa abbatreh, velemru leh: "assa kalba achsa tarnegola"; veligbe shav umetze mishshiva batte, velittevinhu nihaleh betzinnora dedashsha, venechlinhu bekilkevle demata. batar hachi, lifshot shudera barka, venemru hachi: "shavrire difloni bar pelonita (shavkinhu) [lishbeku] lifloni bar pelonita, velicharu lechalba bevavita deeneh".

Leshavrire dimama – layte shiva summake miggauo dechevta, venitvinhu achaspa deummana; velitev ihu miggavvay veinish acharina meabbaray, venema leh avvira: "hav li deechol", venema leh haych peticha: "sav echol"; uvatar deachel litbereh lechaspa, dei la – hadri illaveh.
Lidma deate minnechira – lete gavra kohen dishmeh levi, velichtov leh levi lemafrea. vei la – layte inish mealma, venichtov leh: "ana pappe shela bar summake" – lemafrea.

Vei la – nichtov leh hachi: taam deli beme chesef, taam deli beme fegam. vei la – layte ikkara deaspasta, veashla defureyay attika, vekuretsa, umorike, vesummaka delulibba; veniklinhu bahade hadade; velayte gevava deamra venigdol tarte petilata, velitmish bechalla, venigadbel bekitma haden, venittev binchireh.

Vei la – lichze ammat hammayim deazla mimmizrach kelappe maarav; venifsa venekum chad kara lehay gisa vechad kara lehay gisa; venishkol tina bideh deyammina mittute kara dismaleh, uvideh dismala mittute kara deyammineh; venigdol tarte petilata deamra venitmish betina, venittev binchireh.
Vei la – letev tute marzava, venayyto mayya velishdo aleh, velemru: "ki hechi defaski hane mayya, lifsok demeh diflanya bar pelanita".
Lidma deate mippumma – badkinan leh begila dechitteta, i sarech – merea kaate veit leh takkanta, vei la – mikkavda kaate velet leh takkanta.
Amar leh rav amme lerav ashe, vehaanan ippecha tenan: nittal hakkaved velo nishtayyer hemenna kelum, harea shennikkeva o shechasra! amar leh: kevan demippummeh kaate, emar ittemoche ittemach.

Amar mar: i merea kaate, it leh takkanta. may takkanteh? layte shiva kune mippirma desilka, veshiva kune pirma decharate, vechamsha kune perida, utelata kune ditlafche, vechuna dechammona, vechuna (dechavle) [detavle]; uchenegdan – kanta petirta; velivashshel velechol, velishte abbatreh shichra charifa detevet.

Lechakka – amar rabba bar rav huna: layte tuma yechidaa venimreseh bemishcha umilcha, venitteveh attuvfra deilyona dehahu gisa dechayev leh, venahdar leh gedanfa delesha. venizdehar levisreh, dekashe lechivvara.

Lechinche – amar rabbi yochanan: chumeti – ki mamru, veikkara dechumeti – adif mimmamru, veninkot befummeh. hane leokome; levashshole – layyte pare deresh nafyay, utelafche beafrayyhu, veshuvelilta, vechumarta dichshuta, veninkot keamguza befummeh.
Leippetoche – linpach leh chavreh tachle chivvarta begila dechitteta. leassoke – layte afra mittulla devet hakkisse, venigbol beduvesha venechol, dimalle leh.

Levarsam – layte ki fisteka denishadur, vechi amguza dechelbenita duveshanita, umele tarvoda duvesha chivvara, umele natla bat machoza chamra nekida; venishlokinhu bahade hadade; vechi beshil nishadur – beshil leh kulleh. vei la – layte revieta dachalava deizza chivvavrti
b: Venittayyfeh attelat kilche kerava, venivchasheh bigvoza demarmehin; vechi beshil gevoza demarmahin – beshil leh kulleh. vei la – layte nifka dechalba chivvara, venigbol benitfa. vechamma deefshar – nifka la nechol, dimfarek.
Legira – layte gira delilita, venefcheh, venishde mayya illaveh venishte. vei la – layte mimmayya deishti minnayyhu kalba belelya; venizdehar miggilluya. legilluya – anpaka dechamra chayyay.
Lemuresa – anpaka dechamra, beahala tolana.

Lefircha delibba – layte telat beroshiyyayta disare, venishterinhu bechamka dela avar illaveh arbein yomin, venechol; venishte abbatrayyhu chamra marka. amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: vechol shekken defarach libbeh! amar leh: ana – leyukera delibba amari;
Lefircha delibba – layte telat beroshiyyayta dechitte, venishterinhu beduvesha venechol, venishte abbatrayyhu chamra chayyay.
Letzircha delibba – layte telat bee ninyay, uveata dechammona, uveata deshuvmsheme, velechol.
Lichev mee – layte telat mea pilpele arichata, vechol yome nishte mea minnayyhu bechamra. ravin demin naresh avad la levarteh derav ashe mea vechamshin mehane didan, veittesiat.
Lechirtza – anpaka dechamra baatarpa dearaa. lechirtza chivvara – layte bizra galgila venitzyeyre beshistag, venityeyreh bemayya venishteye; venizdehar mibbinta, dei la – menakkeva la lemayayneh.
Lemesar – sisin rattiva bemayya. lemishre – yabbishta bemayya. vesimanach: itza rattiv[ta]1 desachar nahara.

Litchala – layte shav bine demayya uneyaybshinhu betulla, vechol yoma nishte tarte vetilta bechamra. vei la – layte techala ditzyfirta dela ippetach, venitchayeh betannura, venoke lahadeh, venema: "ki hechi deyabbish hay techala, niyyaybash techaleh difloni bar pelonita".

Vei la – nitchayeh bene ureve deveta chadta, venema hachi. vei la, livke shachva dishchev beshabbeta, venishkeleh lideh venotva attechaleh, venema: "ki hechi deyabbish ha yeda, niyyaybash techaleh difloni bar pelonita".
Vei la – nayte binita venitvevyeh be nappacha, venechleh bemayya deve nappacha, venishte mimmayya deve nappacha. hahi izza dahavat shatya mayya deve nappacha, ishtechit – vela ishtechach la techala.
Vei la – liftach chavita dechamra lishmeh. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: i it leh chavita dechamra, la ate lekammeh demar. ella margal befat shacharit, dimalleya lechulle gufeh.

Lerushechata – layte akkika, veilvo, veaspircha, umartecha, vechumarta defilon, usheyafa dachamimta, veninkot beshachake dechittana – bekayyta, vedaamar gufena – besitva. vei la – lishte shichra marka.
Leshigrona – layte patya demonine, venigandereh shittin zimne aha metachteh, veshittin zimne aha metachteh.
Litzmirta – nete telat nittufeyayta mishcha dechufera, utelat nittufeyayta itzra decharate, utelat nittufeyayta dechamra nekida, velishde leh leish – baamma, uleishsha – beoto makom.
Vei la – layte unna dezika, velitle leh leish baamma, uleishsha baddaddin. vei la – layte chote dizhorita disdoteha duma bat duma, velitle leh leish baamma uleishsha baddaddin.

Vei la – layte kinna dezachar unekeva, velitle leh leish baamma uleishsha beoto makom; vechi mashtin, nashtin assisana yabbishta betzinnora dedashsha, uneayyen bechumarta denafka minneh, dimalleya lechullehu tzimri.

Letzimra bara – layte telata gerive sufele, utelata gerive atraf addara, venishlokinhu kol chad lechodeh; velitev benayyhu; velotvinhu betarte meshichle, venayte patura venannach illaveh, venekum meillave hay velevtev illave hay, umeillave hay velevtev illave hay, ad denissak beh havela; velische minnayyhu, vechi shate – mimmayya deaddara lishte, mimmayya desufele la lishte; mishshum dimyakkeri.
Letzimra gavvna – layte shiva bune desilka mishshav meshare, venishlokinhu beafrayyhu, venechol, venishte atraf addara beshichra, o

a: Inve taala bemayim.
Lachazazita – layte shav chitte arzanyayta, veniklinhu ammara chadta, venafek mishcha minnayyhu, veneshuf. rav shimi bar ashe avad leh lehahu goy ledavar acher, veittassi.
Amar shemuel: hay man dimcho leh baalonke defarsae, michyay la chaye; addehachi vehachi, nispo leh bisra shammina aggumere, vechamra chayyay, efshar dechaye pureta umefakked abbeteh.
Amar rav idi bar avin: hay man divla zibbura – michyay la chaye, addehachi vehachi nashkeye revieta dechalla shamgaz, efshar dechaye pureta umefakked leveteh.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: achal besar shor belefet, velan ballevana belele arbaa asar o chamishsha asar bitkufat tammuz – ochazto achilu.

Tana: vehamemalle kereso mikkol davar, ochazto achilu. amar rav pappa: afillu mittamre. peshita! salka datach amena, hoil veamar mar: tamre – masbean, umeshachanan, umeshalshelan, umeashsheran vela mefannekan; ema la, ka mashma lan.
May achilu? amar rabbi elazar: esh shel atzamot. may "esh shel atzamot"? amar abbaye: esh garme.
May asuteh? amar abbaye, amara li em: kullehu shakyayne – telata, veshiva, uteresar; vehay – ad demittasse.

Kullehu shakyayne – allibba rekana, vehay – batar deachel, veshate, veayel levet hakkisse, venafek umashe yedeh. umayytu leh buna dishtita ditlafche, uvuna dechamra attika, venigbelinhu bahade hadade venechol; venichroch bisdineh, venaygneye, velekka denokmeh ad dekae minnafsheh; vechi kae, lishkeleh lisdineh minneh, vei la, hadar illaveh.
Amar leh eliyyahu lerabbi natan: echol shelish ushete shelish vehannach shelish – lichshettichos, taamod al milluecha.

Tane rabbi chiyyay: harotze shello yavo lide choli meayim, yehe ragil betibbul – kayitz vachoref; seudatcha shehanaatcha mimmenna – meshoch yadcha hemenna; veal teshahe atzmecha beshaa sheatta tzarich linkavecha.
Amar mar ukeva: hay man deshate tilya chivvara – ochazto vittek. amar rav chisda: shittin mine chamra havo, mealleya dechullehu – summaka rechatana, geria dechullehu – tilya chivvara.
Amar rav yehuda: hay man deyatev betzafrane nisan gabbe nura, veshayef mishcha, venafek veyatev beshimsha – ochazto vittak.

Tanu rabbanan: hikkiz dam veshimmesh mittato – hoviyn lo banim vittekin. hikkizu shenehem veshimmeshu – hoviyn lahen banim baale ratan. amar rav pappa: la amaran ella dela taem midde, aval taem midde – let lan ba.

Amar rabba bar rav huna: ba min hadderech veshimmesh mittato – hoviyn lo banim vittekin. tanu rabbanan: habba mibbet hakkisse, al yeshammesh mittato ad sheyyishhe shiur chatzi mil, mippene sheshshed bet hakkisse melavve immo; veim shimmesh – hoviyn lo banim nichpim.
Tanu rabbanan: hameshammesh mittato meummad – ochazto avit; meyushshav – ochazto dalarya; hi millemala vehu millematta – ochazto dalarya.
May dalarya? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: sam dalarya – dardara. may dardara? amar abbaye: morika dechoche. rav pappa ales uvala leh. rav pappe ales veshade leh.
Amar abbaye: mi sheeno baki bederech eretz, lete shelosha kefize kuretme dechoche, venedukinhu, venishlekinhu bechamra venishte. amar rabbi yochanan: hen hen hechziruni lenaaruti.

Shelosha devarim machchishim kocho shel adam, veellu hen: pachad, derech veavon. pachad – dichtiv: "libbi secharchar azavani chochi". derech – dichtiv: "inna vadderech kochi". avon – dichtiv: "kashal baavoni chochi".
Shelosha devarim mattizin gufo shel adam, veellu hen: achal meummad, veshata meummad, veshimmesh mittato meummad.
Chamishsha kerovin lemita yoter min hachayyim, veellu hen: achal veamad, shata veamad, hikkiz dam veamad, yashen veamad, shimmesh mittato veamad.

Shishsha, haose otan – miyyad met, veellu hen: habba badderech venityayga, hikkiz dam, venichnas levet hammerchatz, veshata venishtakker, veyashan al gabbe karka, veshimmesh mittato. amar rabbi yochanan: vehu sheasaan kesidran.
Amar abbaye: kesidran – met, shello kesidran – chalesh. ini?! veha meurat avada leh leavda telat minnayyhu, umit! hahu kachush hava.
Shemona – rubban kashe umiutan yafe, veellu hen: derech, vederech eretz, osher, umelacha, yayin, veshena, chammin, vehakkazat dam.
Shemona memaatim et hazzera, veellu hen: hammelach, veharaav, vehannetek, bechiyyay, veshena al gabbe karka, vegudgedaniyyot, ucheshut shello bizmannah, vehakkazat dam lematta – kiflayim.
Tana: keshem shekkasha lematta kiflayim, kach yafa lemala – kiflayim. amar rav pappa:
b: Lematta – lematta min habbetzim, lemala – lemala min habbetzim.
Ucheshut shello bizmannah. tana: keshem shekkasha shello bizmannah, kach yafa bizmannah. amar rav pappa: zemannah – tammuz, shello bizmannah – tevet, yome nisan veyome tishre – la meallu vela kashu.

Amar: "kitvu get leishti", vaachazo kuredyaykos, vechazar veamar: "al tichtevu" – en devarav haacharonim kelum. amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kotvin venotnin get lealtar. verabbi yochanan amar: en kotvin ella lichsheyyishtappe.

May tama deresh lakish? dekatane: en bidvarav haacharonim kelum. verabbi yochanan amar lach: en bidvarav haacharonim kelum – dilchi mittetzil la tzerich lemihdar immeloche beh; uleolam en kotvin ella lichsheyyishtappe.
Bemay kamippalgi? resh lakish medamme leh leyashen, verabbi yochanan medamme leh leshote.
Verabbi yochanan name lidammeye leyashen! yashen – la mechussar maase, hay – mechussar maase.
Veresh lakish name nidammeyeh leshote! shote la sammeh bidan, hay, sammeh bidan – bisra summaka aggumere, vechamra marka.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi?! vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shachat bo shenayim, o rov shenayim, veramaz veamar: "kitvu get leishti" – hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu;
Vetanya: rauhu meguyyad o tzaluv al hatztzeliva, veramaz veamar: "kitvu get leishti" – hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam data tzilluta hi, uchechishuta hu deatchila beh; hacha data shegishta hi.
Umi amar shemuel hachi?! vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shachat bo shenayim o rov shenayim, uvarach – meidin alav. vei salka datach chay hu, ammay meidin alav?
Amri: chay hu – vesofo lamut.
Ella meatta, yehe gole al yado! allema tanya: shachat bo shenayim o rov shenayim – hare ze eno gole?
Ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi hoshaya: chayyshinan shemma haruach bilbelattu. i name, hu kerav et mitato.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deshachteh beveta deshesha, ufayrkes. i name, deshachteh bevara, vela payrkes.
Nishtattek, veamru lo: "nichtov get leishtecha" kulei. velechush dilma shichya delav lav" nakteh, i name shichya dehen hen" nakteh!
Amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: deamrinan leh beserugin.
Velechush dilma shichya deserugin nakteh! deamrinan leh chad "lav" uteren "hen", uteren "lav" vechad "hen".
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: omrim lo devarim shel yemot hachamma bimot haggeshamim, veshel yemot haggeshamim bimot hachamma.
May nihu? illema gelufekre usedine – lechush dilma kora achdeh, i name chamma achdeh!

a: Ella befere.

Amar rav kahana amar rav: cheresh sheyyachol ledabber mittoch hakketav, kotvin venotnin get leishto. amar rav yosef: may ka mashma lan? tenena: nishtattek, veamru lo: "nichtov get leishtecha?" vehirkin berosho, bodkin oto shelosha peamim, im amar al lav – "lav", veal hen – "hen", hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu.
Amar leh rabbi zera: illem kaamrat? shane illem – detanya: medabber veeno shomea – zehu cheresh, shomea veeno medabber – zehu illem, veze vaze hare hen kefikchin lechol divrehem.
Umimmay dimdabber veeno shomea zehu cheresh, shomea veeno medabber zehu illem? dichtiv: "vaani checheresh lo eshma ucheillem lo yiftach piv". vei baet ema, kidamri inashe: ishtekil milluleh.
Amar rabbi zera: i kashya li – ha kashya li, detanya: "im lo yaggid" – perat leillem, sheeno yachol lehaggid. ammay? ha yachol lehaggid mittoch hakketav!
Amar leh abbaye: edut kaamrat? shane edut, derachamana amar: "mippihem" – velo mippi chetavam.
Metivi: keshem shebbodkin oto legittin, kach bodkin oto lemassaot, ulemattanot, uleediyyot, velirushshot. katane mihat – "ediyyot"!
Amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav sheshet: beedut ishsha, daakillu ba rabbanan.
Veha katane: "yerushshot"! amar rabbi avahu: yerushshat beno habbechor.
Katane mihat – "lemassaot ulemattanot", may, lav lealma? la, ledideh.
Metivi: cheresh, lo halchu bo achar remizotav veachar kefitzotav veachar ketav yado, ella bemittaltelin; aval lo legittin.
Tannae hi – detanya, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim – becheresh meikkaro, aval pikkeach venitcharesh – hu kotev vehen chotmin.
Vecheresh meikkaro – lo?! keshem shekkonsah birmiza, kach motziah birmiza!
I beishto, hachi name; hacha bemay askinan – bivimto.
Yevimto mimman? ilema dinfala leh meachiv cheresh – keshem shekkenisatah birmiza, kach yetziatah birmiza! ella dinfala leh meachiv pikkeach.
Veibbaet ema: leolam dinfala leh meachiv cheresh, ugezera achiv cheresh attu achiv pikkeach.
I hachi, ishto name! yevimto bivimto michallefa, ishto bivimto la michallefa.
Umi gazrinan cheresh attu pikkeach?!
b: Vehatnan: shene achin chershin – nesuin shete achayot pikkechot, o shete achayot chershot, o shete achayot achat pikkachat veachat chereshet; vechen shete achayot chershot – nesuot lishne achin pikkechin, o lishne achin chershin, o lishne achin echad pikkeach veechad cheresh – hare ellu peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum.
Veim hayu nochriyyot, yikkansu; veim ratzu lehotzian – yotziu.
Ella mechavvavrta kidshannin meikkara.
Amar rabbi yochanan: chalukin alav chaverav al rabban shimon ben gamliel.
Amar abbaye, af anan name tenena: nishshattet, lo yotzi. nitcharesh hu o nishtatta – lo yotzi olamit. may "olamit"? lav – af al gav deyachol ledabber mittoch hakketav?
Amar rav pappa: i lav deashmeinan rabbi yochanan, hava amena rabban shimon ben gamliel lefaroshe tama detanna kamma hu daata; umay "olamit"? af al gav dachazena leh decharif.
I name, lechidrabbi yitzchak – deamar rabbi yitzchak: devar tora, shota mitgareshet – midde dehave appikkachat beal korchah.
Uma taam amru enah mitgareshet – shello yinhagu bah minhag hefker.

Mishna amru lo: "nichtov get leishtecha?" veamar lahen: "ketovu"; amru lassofer vechatav, velaedim vechatmu; af al pi shekketavuhu vachatamuhu unetanuhu lo, vechazar unetano lah – hare hagget batel, ad sheyyomar lassofer "ketov" velaedim "chatomu".
Gemara tama delo amar "tenu", ha amar "tenu" – notnin, manni? rabbi meir hi, deamar: mille mimmasran leshaliach.
Ema sefa: "ad sheyyomar lassofer ketov velaedim chatomu" – atan lerabbi yose, deamar: mille la mimmasran leshaliach.
Resha rabbi meir vesefa rabbi yose?! in, resha rabbi meir vesefa rabbi yose.
Abbaye amar: kullah rabbi meir hi, vehacha bemay askinan – dela amar "tenu". i hachi, "ad sheyyomar tenu" mibbee leh!
Ella hacha bemay askinan – dela amar leve telata. i hachi, "ad sheyyomar lishlosha" mibbee leh!
Ella kulla rabbi yose hi, vehacha bemay askinan – dela amar "imru".
I hachi, "ad sheyyomar imru" mibbee leh!
Veod, mi mode rabbi yose beomer: "imru"?! vehatnan: "katav sofer veed – kasher"; veamar rabbi yirmeya: "chatam sofer" shaninu. veamar rav chisda: matnitin manni –

a: Rabbi yose hi, deamar: mille la mimmasran leshaliach.

Vei salka datach mode rabbi yose beomer "imru", nafek minna chureba – dezimnin deamar lehu lishnayim "imru lesofer veyichtov, velifloni ufeloni veyachtomu"; umishshum kissufa desofer – chayyshi umachtemi leh, uvaal la amar hachi.
Ella mechavvavrta, resha rabbi meir vesefa rabbi yose.

Rav ashe amar: kulla rabbi yose hi, vela mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya hecha dela amar "tenu", ella afillu amar "tenu" – la. vela mibbaya hecha dela amar leve telata, ella afillu amar leve telata – la. vela mibbaya hecha dela amar "imru", ella afillu amar "imru" – name la.

Tanya kevoteh derav ashe: katav sofer lishmah vechatmu edim lishmah, af al pi shekketavuhu vachatamuhu unetanuhu lo unetano lah – hare hagget batel, ad sheyyishmeu kolo sheyyomar lassofer "ketov" velaedim "chatomu".
"Yishmeu" – leappoke mimman deamar, mode rabbi yose beomer: "imru". "kolo" – leappoke midderav kahana amar rav.
Mishna "ze gittich im matti"; "ze gittich mecholi ze"; "ze gittich leachar mita" – lo amar kelum. "mehayyom im matti"; "meachshav im matti" – hare ze get.
"Mehayyom uleachar mita" – get veeno get; veim met – choletzet, velo mityaybemet.
"Ze gittich mehayyom, im matti mecholi ze", veamad vehalach bashshuk, vechala vamet – omdin oto, im mechamat choli harishon met – hare ze get, veim lav – eno get.
Gemara alma "im matti" kilachar mita" dame, vahadar tane: "mehayyom im matti"; "meachshav im matti" – alma "im matti" lav kilachar mita" dame!
Amar abbaye: "im matti" – shete leshonot mashma; mashma kemeachshav, umashma kilachar mita;
Amar lah "mehayyom" – keman deamar lah "meachshav" dame, lo amar lah "mehayyom" – keman deamar lah "leachar mita" dame.
"Ze gittech im matti" – lo amar kelum: amar rav huna: vecholetzet.
Veha "lo amar kelum" katane! lo amar kelum – daasira lealma; uleyavam name asira.
Veha middesefa choletzet, mikkelal deresha yabbome name miyyabbema! matnitin kerabbanan;
Verav huna deamar kerabbi yose, deamar: zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav.
I rabbi yose, chalitza name la tive! vechi tema mesappeka leh lerav huna i hilcheta kerabbi yose o en halacha kerabbi yose; umi mesappeka leh?!

Veha rabba bar avu chalash, ul legabbeh rav huna verav nachman; amar leh rav huna lerav nachman, bei minneh merabba bar avu: halacha kerabbi yose, o en halacha? amar leh: tama derabbi yose la yadana, halacha eve minneh?! amar leh: at bei minneh halacha, vetameh derabbi yose ana amena lach.
Bea minneh. amar leh, hachi amar rav: halacha kerabbi yose. levatar dinfak amar leh: hayeynu tama derabbi yose – dekasavar: zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav! ella mesappeka leh
b: I amar rabbi yose beal pe, i la amar.
Umi mesappeka leh?! vehatnan: "hare ze gittich im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh – eno get. vetane ala: rabbotenu hittiruha lehinnashe.
Veamrinan: man rabbotenu? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: be dina dishro mishcha; vesavri la kerabbi yose, deamar: zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav.
Ella mesappeka leh i halacha kerabbi yose beal pe, o en halacha.
Umi mesappeka leh?! vehaamar rava: "hare ze gittich im matti" vesheani met" – hare ze get. "kesheamut" uleachar mita" – en ze get.
Hechi dame? ilema deamar la "mehayyom", verabbanan; tzericha lememar?! vehatnan: "mehayyom im matti" – hare ze get! veella lav dela amar la "mehayyom", verabbi yose? shema minna halacha kerabbi yose!
Lerava peshita leh, lerav huna mesappeka leh.
Veibbaet ema: leolam daamar la "mehayyom" – verabbanan, vehane lishshane itzterichi leh: "sheani met" – keim matti" dame; "kesheamut" – kilachar mita" dame.
Veikka dematne la assefa: "ze gittich leachar mita" – lo amar kelum. amar rav huna: uledivre rabbi yose, choletzet.
Peshita, middesefa – lerabbanan choletzet, resha name – lerabbi yose choletzet!
Mahu detema, rabbi yose beha kerabbi sevira leh – deamar: gitta mealleya have, vachalitza name la tive; ka mashma lan dela rabbi savar la kerabbi yose, vela rabbi yose savar la kerabbi.
Rabbi la savar la kerabbi yose – dekatane: "kaze – get", lemaote derabbi yose; verabbi yose la savar la kerabbi – dekatane: "kaze – get", lemaote derabbi.
Rabbi may hi? detanya: "mehayyom uleachar mita" – get veeno get, divre chachamim; rabbi omer: kaze – get.

Rabbi yose may hi? ditnan: "kitvu utenu get leishti, im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh", ketavuhu betoch shenem asar chodesh unetanuhu leachar shenem asar chodesh – eno get; rabbi yose omer: kaze – get.
"Ze gittich mehayyom, im matti mecholi ze", veamad vehalach bashshuk kulei.
Amar rav huna: gitto kemattenato; ma mattenato, im amad – chozer; af gitto, im amad – chozer.
Uma gitto – af al gav dela paresh, kevan deamar "ketovu" – af al gav dela amar "tenu"; af mattenato, kevan deamar "tenu" – af al gav dela keno minneh.

Tenan: "ze gittich mehayyom, im matti mecholi ze", veamad vehalach bashshuk, vechala vamet; omdim oto – im mechamat choli harishon met, hare ze get; im lav, eno get. vei amrat "im amad – chozer", lema li umedana? hare amad!
Amar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava: shennittak mecholi lecholi.
